achievements/achievement_01_desc: Explore at least 50% of a mission area before setting up your HQ in survival.
achievements/achievement_02_desc: Mr. Riggs "dies" and drops the last weapon he was holding.
achievements/achievement_04_desc: Fire 2 miniguns at the same time nonstop for 15 seconds.
achievements/achievement_05_desc: No need for Scotty here. Make 101 rift jumps.
achievements/achievement_06_desc: Build your first Communications Hub in the campaign or the survival mode.
achievements/achievement_07_desc: You really want to keep it clean. Destroy 10 000 destructibles.
achievements/achievement_09_desc: Make a big bang. Place a Nuclear Mine.
achievements/achievement_10_desc: Get your hands dirty! Kill 500 aliens with Mr Riggs' bare hands.
achievements/achievement_11_desc: Leave nothing behind. Extract at least 75% of resource veins in any map.
achievements/achievement_12_desc: You are a horrible person! Exterminate 1000 neutral creatures.
achievements/achievement_13_desc: No stone unturned. Find at least 75% of hidden underground treasures on any map.
achievements/achievement_16_desc: Simultaneously mine every resource type in the game.
achievements/achievement_17_desc: Complete any Survival by building only Solar, Wind, Biomass or Geothermal powerplants.
achievements/achievement_18_desc: Have all the available upgrade, consumable and weapon slots filled.
achievements/achievement_19_desc: I am the swarm. Have 50 drones of any kind active at the same time.
achievements/achievement_22_desc: Build an outpost on 4 different biomes in campaign mode.
achievements/achievement_24_desc: Nothing gets by you. Cover at least 75% of any map with radar coverage.
achievements/achievement_25_desc: Build an Extreme Quality Sword and fully mod it with 3 Extreme mods.
achievements/achievement_27_desc: Equip every single weapon slot for Mr. Riggs with extreme variant gear.
achievements/achievement_28_desc: Vacation on Galatea 37 complete! Finish the campaign or the survival mode.
achievements/achievement_29_desc: Complete all research in one tech tree.
achievements/achievement_30_desc: Read at least 75% of entries in the encyclopedia/bestiary
achievements/achievement_35_desc: Transfer 5000 of any liquid through compressor/decompressor.
achievements/achievement_36_desc: Finish survival or story on metallic biome.
achievements/achievement_37_desc: Dig through or destroy 1000 cavern walls.
achievements/achievement_39_desc: Kill 100 enemies with the crystal walls' explosion.
achievements/achievement_41_desc: Open 10 bioanomalies in the Crystal Caverns biome.
achievements/achievement_42_desc: Finish survival mode in the Crystal Caverns biome or the Into The Dark story campaign.
achievements/achievement_44_name: Are we the bad guys now?
achievements/achievement_45_desc: Extract resources from Poogret’s poo – 10 times
achievements/achievement_46_desc: Shred 250 destructible props with a tornado skill.
achievements/achievement_48_desc: Finish survival mode in the Fungal Swamp biome or the Swamp story campaign.
achievements/achievement_50_name: But is it better than mine?
achievements/achievement_52_desc: Use the "Search" option in Research or Inventory.
achievements/achievement_53_desc: Scan for a new location on Galatea 37.
achievements/achievement_55_desc: Achieve your final goal and save Galatea 37
common_loading/pre_alpha_info_1: You're playing a Beta build of the Riftbreaker.\n Please note that you may experience various problems and unfinished/unbalanced game aspects.\n Work in progress :)
common_loading/pre_alpha_info_2:
This build contains:

 Introductory Mission – a scripted, pre-built mission that is intended to walk you through basic gameplay aspects. 

 Survival – a random generated unscripted mission in which your primary goal is to survive a set amount of time, until you can open a rift portal back to Earth.
dialog/demo/ashley_base_defenses_01: Let's set up some walls and Sentinel Towers. Focus our defences on the western direction. They never change the beginning of this excercise...
dialog/demo/ashley_base_defenses_02: Slaughtering indigineous creatures was never my area of expertise…
dialog/demo/ashley_base_defenses_03: We're ready for them Mr Riggs. Remember to use repair kits if necessary.
dialog/demo/ashley_base_defenses_04: Mr Riggs is the only companion that I need. We can handle the unknown, just let us do our job.
dialog/demo/ashley_build_hq_01: HQ construction in progress. Sometimes I wish we could fast forward this part of the simulation...
dialog/demo/ashley_build_hq_02: Slaughtering indigineous creatures was never my area of expertise...
dialog/demo/ashley_build_or_attack: We'll need an Ironium Factory to build more defenses. We'll have to find an ore deposit to build one. Hunting down some critters also sounds interesting.
dialog/demo/ashley_choose_objective_01: We didn't have any time to study the creatures that are attacking us, the only thing we can do right now is fight them or strengthen our defenses. We'll need an Ironium Factory to build more towers. We'll have to find an ore deposit to build one.
dialog/demo/ashley_hello: Don't worry Mr. Riggs, our sentinel towers will take care of this. Let's watch them do the shooting, while I stretch our joints a little.
dialog/demo/ashley_nest: This looks like a hive of some sort. Let's look inside to see if it's occupied.
dialog/demo/ashley_nest_2: It looks like we've cleared them out. Let's hope this will give us some time to build up our base.
dialog/demo/ashley_nest_3: Let's gather all of the research samples and rare resources that were in this nest. We can study them later and use them to craft better equipment.
dialog/demo/ashley_nest_4: There's more than a single species of creatures around this nest. We should be careful.
dialog/demo/ashley_nest_5: I wonder if that's just a part of the simulation or if the Galatean creatures are really going to be that smart. That would make studying them much more interesting.
dialog/demo/ashley_place_towers: That's true. We have to place a few more towers to the east of our base in case some of these creatures decide to visit while we're not around.
dialog/demo/ashley_reporting_01: Houston, this is Ashley. Reporting rift jump successful.
dialog/demo/ashley_second_attack: Ok. Let's show them they're not welcome here.
dialog/demo/ashley_second_attack_defende: It looks like we fended them off, but I'm sure there will be more of them coming to our base. We need to secure our presence here.
dialog/demo/ashley_simulation_02: It's enough to know that we can survive there. I can't wait to make the jump. Everything is going to be new there and waiting to be studied and explored...
dialog/demo/ashley_simulation_03: Let's not get dramatic Mr Riggs. A 5 meters tall mecha-suit with miniguns and power blades should be enough to fend of a few hungry creatures.
dialog/demo/ashley_steel_factory: Ok Mr Riggs, we've got Ironium production up and running.
dialog/demo/ashley_steel_factory_attack: They're not going to give us a break, are they?
dialog/demo/ashley_steel_factory_attack_: The HQ has a permanent rift portal. We can rift jump to its location at any moment. Let's go!
dialog/demo/ashley_steel_factory_towers: Sentinel towers, are ready. They should be able to fend off small groups of attackers.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive: It looks like we've really made them mad this time. We have to build up more defenses!
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_01: We don't have much time. We have to set up as many defensive towers as we can. Also remember to build up more walls and lay all the mines that we can.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_02: We still have some time Mr Riggs. We can set up multiple layers of walls around our base and place as many defensive towers as we can. You can also use your drill to excavate additional resources if our factories are producing them too slow.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_03: This is it Mr Riggs. Ready your guns. Let's show them what we can do.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_04: That was easy. I'm not sure if it's worth wasting resources on setting up any more defenses.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_06: Things are escalating quickly. We have to gear up before the second wave hits our walls. Let's show them who they're dealing with.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_07: This attack was a lot stronger. I don't know if we can hold out much longer. Wild animals do not behave like that. They shouldn't act like a sentient army.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_08: I'm disabling all secondary systems and diverting all power to your guns. It's either us or them.
dialog/demo/ashley_survive_09: There's too many of them. We're getting overrun.
dialog/demo/houston_base_defenses_01: Captain Nowak, we all know your renowned scientific background, but your combat performance in the previous simulation was far from spectacular.
dialog/demo/houston_base_defenses_02: Since you've already done this a couple of times, we've introduced some new additions to this course. We'll see what your area of expertise really is…
dialog/demo/houston_base_defenses_03: Well done Captain Nowak. The purpose of this training excercise is to prepare you for intense combat situations. This simulation is based on our long distance scans of Galatea 37. They may or may not be accurate. You will be alone out there. There will be no communication back home until you can stabilize a rift portal back to Earth. You will have to rely only on your skills and your Mecha-suit.
dialog/demo/houston_begin_base_setup_01: Roger that, begin field base setup.
dialog/demo/houston_build_hq_01: Captain Nowak, let me remind you that even though this is a simulated training exercise, you are expected to perform as if it was your real mission on Galatea 37.
dialog/demo/houston_survive_01: Captain Nowak, you're not the only candidate for the mission to Galatea 37. You'd better up those combat statistics if you want to qualify for that jump. We're investing too many resources into this mission just to send a scientist that's going to be eaten by a pack of angry animals. Show us that you can survive out there!
dialog/demo/houston_survive_02: You will be going to an alien planet, full of unkown life forms. Do not assume that you know what kind of dangers might be lurking there. Your primary objective is to survive. If something is trying to kill you, it doesn't matter if it is sentient or not. Adapt or die!
dialog/demo/houston_survive_03: We're pulling you out Captain Nowak. You weren't meant to survive this final attack wave. It should serve as a reminder that you should never understimate the threat that you may be dealing with, even if you think you are in control. Your performance during this training session was satisfactory. You can start preparing for your trip to Galatea 37.
dialog/demo/houston_survive_04: What? How did you survive that? You weren't supposed to destroy the final attack. This is outstanding! Congratulations Nowak. I'm sure you'll survive whatever Galatea has in store for you. You can start preparing for the jump.
dialog/demo/mech_base_defenses_01: Ashley. I'm detecting a lot of movement to the west. We should build up a defensive perimeter around the base.
dialog/demo/mech_base_defenses_02: I'm detecting a large group of creatures heading towards our position. Prepare for a fight.
dialog/demo/mech_base_defenses_ready: These basic defenses should give us a bit of security, but we should try to surround our entire base with walls and defensive towers,
dialog/demo/mech_build_or_attack: A quick analysis suggests two effective strategies: One - build more defenses. Two - Destroy all hostile creatures' nests  that are present in this area
dialog/demo/mech_choose_objective_01: Ashley. We should further secure and expand our base. You can build more defenses or go out and clear out hostile creatures' nests to prevent further attacks.
dialog/demo/mech_hello: Good morning Ashley. My sensors are picking up a large Canoptrix swarm heading towards the base.
dialog/demo/mech_nest: We've cleared out this nest, this will decrease the strength of their attacks.
dialog/demo/mech_nest_2: We've destroyed the nest. Even though there were multiple species of creatures around here, they appeared as if all of them were working together against us.
dialog/demo/mech_place_towers: These attacks are getting constantly stronger. We need to tighten our defenses.
dialog/demo/mech_radar: We should build a radar to detect these attacks further in advance.
dialog/demo/mech_rift: Ashley, I would strongly advise you to place a Rift Portal near this factory. This way we can quickly get back to this location if it comes under threat.
dialog/demo/mech_rift_instruction: Select any of the available Rift Portals to instantly teleport to that location. Traveling through Rifts is almost instant and doesn't consume any resources.
dialog/demo/mech_second_attack: I'm detecting a large group of creatures heading towards our base.
dialog/demo/mech_second_attack_defended: I'm not detecting any more hostile creatures in the base's vicinity.
dialog/demo/mech_simulation_01: This shouldn't be here. It's an error in the simulation's construct. This environment has been created by combining long distance quantum scans of Galatea37 and other known planets that share similar properties. Gathering all of this data has taken many years and we were only able to scan a small fraction of the planet.
dialog/demo/mech_steel_factory: This looks like a large deposit of ore. Build an Ironium Factory in this area and power it with a Carbonium Power Plant.
dialog/demo/mech_steel_factory_attack: I'm detecting hostile creatures heading towards our new mining outpost.
dialog/demo/mech_steel_factory_defended: Ashley, we've defended the mining base, but I'm sensing another attack heading towards our Headquarters. We should return there quickly.
dialog/demo/mech_steel_factory_towers: It would also be advised to place additional sentinel towers to defend this outpost. Remember to connect the towers to the power grid using Energy Connectors.
dialog/demo/mech_survive: I'm detecting numerous groups of alien creatures heading towards our base.
dialog/demo/mech_survive_01: Warning! I'm detecting a huge swarm of enemy creatures heading towards our base. It's showing up on my seismic detectors, it's much bigger than anything we've seen before.
dialog/demo/mech_survive_02: I can sense the hostile swarm moving closer towards our base. This attack is going to be much bigger than anything that we've seen before.
dialog/demo/mech_survive_03: Warning! The alien swarm is approaching. Shields enabled. Maximizing power output.
dialog/demo/mech_survive_04: Ashley, we've defeated the first attack wave. Quickly, repair whatever you can. There should be more of them coming.
dialog/demo/mech_survive_05: Warning! More enemies are heading towards our base.
dialog/demo/mech_survive_06: Second attack wave defeated. Ashley, build up whatever you can. We don't know what's coming next.
dialog/demo/mech_survive_07: Warning! More enemies are heading towards our base. Threat level maximum!
dialog/demo/mech_survive_08: Situation critical. I'm re-reouting all power to life preservation systems.
dialog/encounters/ashley_acid_arachnoid_: Interesting, that is a highly unusual configuration. They typically appear solo. Let's check if they are guarding something.
It's very rare to see multiple Bioanomalies so close to each other. This place feels so strange.

We've seen them many times across the globe. They have different characteristics in each biome, but they are always covered with a strange type of growth. I tried collecting samples of it, but they always disintegrate when we try to do that.

Yes, I think so too. These things clearly want to be left alone. We've never seen any of the native species interacting with them. They also don't seem to affect the environment around them. Almost as if they were invisible.
It's really hard to say without gathering more data. Maybe we can find something out if we keep opening them up. I know we'll find out something useful one way or another.
dialog/encounters/ashley_acid_hostile_ne: This is unusual. I'm seeing black smoke up ahead. It's either something burning or there's an active volcano over there.
We haven't seen a lot of volcanoes in this part of the world, let's check it out.
The one in the middle is enormous. It's going to be a tough fight.
Good, this encounter was quite unexpected. This species doesn't usually appear in the Acidic Plains. They must have migrated towards the volcanic fissure.
dialog/encounters/ashley_anomaly_detecte: Interesting. Can you locate these readings?
Ok, you have my attention. Can you share any more specific information?
Noted. Can you provide coordinates for the source?
Understood. Can you explain the nature of the anomaly?
Ok, let's try to find it ourselves in the meantime.
Alright, we will keep moving and see what turns up.
Understood. I will continue searching until you have something solid.
Guess we’ll have to do it the old-fashioned way for now. We’ll poke around and see what we find.
Just let me know when you've got something concrete. I’ll keep moving.
dialog/encounters/ashley_anomaly_locatio: Excellent. Mark it on our map and let's see what it is.
Alright, let’s see what kind of weirdness we’re dealing with.
Nice. I’ve been waiting to figure out what created that signal.
Good. Let’s not keep the mystery waiting.
Excellent. Let’s find out what it is.
dialog/encounters/ashley_caverns_green_e: Roger that, Mr. Riggs. Let's move closer to see what it is.
Wow, this looks like a natural nuclear reactor. As much as this is surprising, things like that existed even on Earth.
Good idea, Mr. Riggs. Let's see what we can find.
dialog/encounters/ashley_caverns_magnet_: It's blocking our sensors. Navigation systems are offline, and we can't rift jump from here.
We found it, Mr. Riggs. It's an enormous Magnetic Rock, much bigger than the ones we've seen in the Volcanic Area.

I think there's a way. We could construct magnetic stabilizers around it and use them to find its resonance frequency. We could then emit a strong magnetic pulse at a frequency that could destabilize these rocks, and hopefully shatter them.
Well, after careful consideration. I agree with your motion of thought. Let's just get out of here.
dialog/encounters/ashley_desert_hands_01: Hold on… do you see that? Those rock pillars—tell me I’m not the only one seeing giant hands sticking out of the ground.
dialog/encounters/ashley_desert_hands_04: I guess you're right. Either way, it does give me the creeps. I wouldn't want to have a base close to this thing.
dialog/encounters/ashley_desert_iceberg_: What? Are these the same Cryo Plants that we've seen in the Volcanic Area.

Interesting, the data that we gathered on this species earlier suggested that it creates a strong chemical reaction with specific volcanic gases. We might be walking on top of an active volcano right now.
Good point, let's do some scanning around these rocks.

The data from the Geoscanner does indeed confirm that we're right in the middle of an ancient caldera with some volcanic activity. I have also detected Titanium ore deposits in the vicinity. These conditions are just enough for the Cryo Plants to survive. However, it does not explain how they got here in the first place. Are they the remnants of an ancient plant colony, or did they arrive here more recently? I will make a note of this for future scientists to study further.
You're right. Let's call this place the Krocoon Mountain.
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_cave_01: Roger that, Mr. Riggs. Let's go check it out.
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_cave_02: Wow, look at this ironium deposit. It's absolutely gigantic.
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_cave_03: That's ok, Mr. Riggs. We can build Drone Mines nearby. They are not as fast as standard automated factories, but they have a long operating range, and they can extract all types of mineable resources. They are slower, but much more versatile.
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_skull_01: Hey, look at that rock over there. It has a very peculiar shape, and I think I see a faint glow coming from one if it's sides. Let's go check it out.
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_skull_02: Ok, now tell me this doesn't look like a skull to you.
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_skull_03: Come on. Are you serious? It's got obvious eye sockets, teeth, and a nose.
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_skull_04: What about the glow that's coming from inside it?
dialog/encounters/ashley_ice_skull_05: This is as much interesting as it is disappointing. Well, I guess there's nothing more to look at here. Carry on.
dialog/encounters/ashley_jungle_hostile_: Wow, it's so nice over here. These water ponds look so clean!
Roger that, Mr Riggs. Let's secure the area. I want to give it a better look once it's safer.
We haven't seen these creatures before, they didn't look native to the Tropical Zone.
How did these Stickrids get here? We haven't seen them outside the Fungal Swamp before. I don't see any traces of the wild fungal growth that we've seen over there.

It looks like they had a hard time adjusting to this environment. They've practically picked this area clean. I'm not sure if they would be able to sustain themselves here for long. Either way, they certainly found a great place to set up camp. Maybe we could set up a small outpost between the lakes, just to drop by now and then to enjoy the view.
dialog/encounters/ashley_jungle_volcano_: Yeah, I see it. It's an active volcanic fissure.
I didn't know this area was volcanically active. It's quite a surprise to see a volcano in this place.

It is certainly less stable, which makes it more dangerous, but also opens up a lot of opportunities. We could, for example, take advantage of all of the gas vents and mineral deposits around this fissure.
dialog/encounters/ashley_magma_acid_01: Look, a sludge pool. We haven't seen these around here.
dialog/encounters/ashley_magma_acid_02: I think I see a large Bioanomaly at the center of the pool. Let's go check it out.
dialog/encounters/ashley_magma_acid_03: This sludge pool has an intriguing spiral shape. I wonder if it's coincidental.
dialog/encounters/ashley_magma_morphium_: Hey, Mr. Riggs. Look over there. Is that Morphium?
This must be an impact crater from one of the X-Morph meteorites. We can take advantage of the Morphium from the pool, but we should watch out for any rogue replicants that might be roaming the area.
dialog/encounters/ashley_metallic_factor: It's huge, I can see it from here.
Oh no. It's moving! We have to destroy it, Mr. Riggs. We can't leave it here like that.
It was much larger than the ones we've seen before. I think it activated because of our presence. I wonder how many of these machines still remain here.
I hope you are right, Mr. Riggs. I hope you are right.
dialog/encounters/ashley_metallic_mud_02: Oh, that's unexpected. This hole is really not that deep. The metallic surface is just a few meters thick.
dialog/encounters/ashley_metallic_mud_03: The thing that comes to my mind right now is the fact that a meteorite of the size that created this crater must have been enormous. This must have been a mass extinction event.
dialog/encounters/ashley_metallic_mud_04: Maybe the X-Morph were trying to slow down before they hit the planet, and the asteroid might have been hollow inside, like a spaceship.
dialog/encounters/ashley_metallic_mud_05: It's such a shame that we weren't able to talk to the X-Morph longer.
dialog/encounters/ashley_metallic_trap_0: Hey, what's this? There's a strong light coming from behind these rocks. Let's go see what it is.
It's a trap! Shields up, Mr. Riggs.
This was a deliberate trap, Mr. Riggs. We have to be extra careful in the Metallic Valley. We have no idea how much is left of these X-Morph.
But what if a security system started to replicate itself?
Oh no, I'd rather increase it than decrease it. We didn't come here to hide under a blanket.
People who prefer stay-at-home jobs don't become Riftbreakers, Mr. Riggs.
dialog/encounters/ashley_swamp_octopus_0: Wow, look over there, Mr. Riggs. What is that thing?
Let's move a little closer to see what it is.

At first, it looked like a giant, frenzied octopus in a smoke cloud, but its movement pattern isn't chaotic. It's doing the same thing over and over again. I think it's spreading the spore cloud with this movement.

The flora and fauna in the Fungal Swamp are weirder than anything I have ever seen. This thing stacks right next to Poogrets, Garlimonium, and the Canceroth. It's like someone was reading too much of H.P. Lovecraft.
It sounds as if he had dreamt of becoming a Riftbreaker.
dialog/encounters/ashley_swamp_stump_01: Wow, look over there, Mr. Riggs. I think we've found the remains of another Great Mushroom Tree.
dialog/encounters/ashley_swamp_stump_02: Let's move closer to check it out.
dialog/encounters/ashley_swamp_stump_03: It looks very old. It must have been beautiful when it was alive. The root system beneath it is very well exposed. It would be fascinating to explore the caverns beneath it.
dialog/encounters/ashley_swamp_stump_04: Interesting, it looks like they are feeding off what's left here. This tree has died from natural causes. It wasn't attacked by the Darkthorn. I guess there is no point in disturbing these bugs. Nature has run its course.
dialog/encounters/mech_acid_arachnoid_pi: Danger! I am detecting two Omega Class creature signatures. They are just beyond the rocks ahead of us. Proceed with extreme caution.
We still do not know what these Bioanomalies are or how they are formed. Neodymium isotope radiometric dating suggests that they are probably older than most life forms on this planet.
The attack waves that these bioanomalies draw to us appear to be their defense mechanism.
They could be an ancient environment monitoring system, or the remains of some specialized life form.
dialog/encounters/mech_acid_hostile_nest: I am detecting multiple heat signatures in that area. It is probably a small lava flow from an open fissure.
Danger! Multiple hostile creature nests ahead of us.
We have cleared all of the hostile creature nests in this area.
dialog/encounters/mech_anomaly_detected_: Ashley, my sensors are picking up anomalous readings within this location.
Ashley, I am detecting some unusual data patterns in this sector.
Anomalous signals detected. Something does not fit within this area.
Something strange is happening in this zone. I am getting readings that are inconsistent with the surrounding environment.
My instruments are detecting anomalous fluctuations in this location. The source is currently unknown.
Yes, but I need some time to gather more data.
The readings are inconsistent. I need more time to analyze the data.
I am in the process of triangulating the origin. Please stand by for updated coordinates. This may take some time.
I have detected a pattern, but it is too weak to determine its origin conclusively. Please give me more time to analyze the data.
My data is fragmented. I need more time to reconstruct its point of origin.
dialog/encounters/mech_anomaly_location_: Data analysis complete. I have an approximate location of the anomaly that I detected earlier.
I have completed processing the data from the anomaly that I recorded a few minutes ago. I have marked its approximate position.
The results of the earlier anomaly scan are conclusive. I am uploading its estimated location to our map.
I have finished analyzing the signals from the previously observed anomaly. I have marked its approximate location.
I have finished processing the data from the anomaly that I recorded earlier. I have calculated an approximate position for investigation.
dialog/encounters/mech_caverns_green_ene: Warning! Dangerous radiation detected. We are approaching a strong gamma-ray emitter.
I am detecting rich uranium ore deposits around this site. You can try to search for them with the Geoscanner.
dialog/encounters/mech_caverns_magnet_02: The source of this magnetic anomaly must be very powerful, but it should not be that difficult to locate. We should find it and neutralize it. Otherwise, it is going to make exploring this area very difficult.
dialog/encounters/mech_caverns_magnet_03: This one is too big to destroy with acidic weapons. There is probably nothing we can do about it. The best solution is to avoid this area.
dialog/encounters/mech_caverns_magnet_04: We could try to do that. However, Magnetic Stabilizers are very expensive to build. We are not sure if this procedure would even work. And there is absolutely zero economic benefit to such an endeavor. After careful analysis and deep data ressearch I suggest a more effective solution. Lets walk away from here.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_hands_01: Warning. Radiation levels are increasing. The amount of Alpha and Beta particles hitting my sensors is off the charts. Gamma-ray emissions are less intense, but slowly approaching dangerous levels.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_hands_02: Affirmative, I see the formations. However, they do not resemble hands in any structural sense. You are experiencing a psychological effect known as Pareidolia.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_hands_03: Pareidolia is the human tendency to perceive familiar shapes—such as faces or limbs—in random or ambiguous visual patterns. These rock formations are coincidental.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_hands_04: Alpha and Beta radiation is a natural product of radioactive decay. These structures are primarily composed of rich Thorium ore. It is much more radioactive than any Thorium ore that could be found on Earth, but it does not appear to be out of place in this radioactive desert.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_iceberg_01: Ashley, I am detecting an abrupt temperature drop just ahead. The shift is anomalous for this biome.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_iceberg_02: Affirmative, they are responsible for the sharp temperature spike around this mountain.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_iceberg_03: We can verify this with the Geoscanner, Ashley.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_iceberg_04: Warning! A group of hostile creatures is heading our way. Prepare for battle.
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_iceberg_05: Threat eliminated. We can continue our investigation, Ashley
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_iceberg_06: Since you are the first to make this discovery, would you like to give it a name?
dialog/encounters/mech_desert_iceberg_07: A fitting name, Ashley. They gave us one hell of a fight here.
dialog/encounters/mech_ice_cave_01: Ashley, my sensors have picked up an unusual gravitational anomaly nearby. I think it might be worth investigating.
dialog/encounters/mech_ice_cave_02: I agree, Ashley. It is much bigger than any we have encountered so far. Unfortunately, we will not be able to extract this ore with our standard Ironium Factories.
dialog/encounters/mech_ice_cave_03: That makes sense. We should try to maximize the effectiveness of Drone Mines by covering as many additional ore deposits with their range as possible.
dialog/encounters/mech_ice_skull_01: Affirmative. This does not look like a skull to me.
dialog/encounters/mech_ice_skull_02: I understand what your brain is telling you, but this most certainly is not a skull. This rock formation is typical of this area. Its geological composition also does not reveal anything out of the ordinary.
dialog/encounters/mech_ice_skull_03: There is a small cavern under this rock that's filled with the Florium Cibarium Corulus plant. This species has particularly strong bioluminescence. It uses it as a lure to attract insects and other small creatures for pollination and seed dispersal. You have just proven its effectiveness.
dialog/encounters/mech_jungle_hostile_hi: Be careful, Ashley. This idyllic scenery may be deceiving. I am detecting a number of hostile nests close by.
They must have migrated here from a different biome. However, I can not detect any visible migration trail. It is not clear how they got here.
Certainly, that sounds like a perfectly logical reason to set up a base. However, mockery aside, this place does look easily defendable, so it might even make some sense.
dialog/encounters/mech_jungle_volcano_01: Ashley, I am registering a sharp thermal spike directly ahead. That area appears geologically unstable.
dialog/encounters/mech_jungle_volcano_02: Be careful, Ashley. I am detecting a lot of hostile presence around it.
dialog/encounters/mech_jungle_volcano_03: Galatea 37 is a young planet with a lot of tectonic activity. Life started to form here much quicker than on Earth.
dialog/encounters/mech_magma_acid_01: Affirmative. It would have evaporated quickly in most areas of this zone, but the temperature around here is noticeably lower. It is only 362 kelvin in this small depression.
dialog/encounters/mech_magma_acid_02: You are seeing things, Ashley. It is just your human imagination playing tricks with your mind.
dialog/encounters/mech_magma_morphium_01: It looks like it. Please move closer so we can verify that.
dialog/encounters/mech_magma_morphium_02: Ashley, I confirm that this is a pool of Morphium. The rocks around it match the ones in the Metallic Valley.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_factory_: Warning! We are approaching a dormant X-Morph biofactory. Proceed with extreme caution.
I do not think that is relevant. They do not seem to pose any danger when left undisturbed. They do not seem to have any centralized intelligence any more.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_mud_01: Ashley, I have picked up something that might be of interest.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_mud_02: That chasm over there contains water and tropical vegetation. Move closer to the edge if you want to see it.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_mud_03: We are near the edge of the Metallic Valley crater, so it makes sense.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_mud_04: The crater is big, but its shape and the deformation of the surrounding geographical features indicate that the impact itself was not as disastrous as you might think. Its velocity might have been lower than you could expect or its density was lower than a typical heavy-metal asteroid.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_mud_06: Who knows, maybe we will still have that chance one day.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_trap_01: Danger! Hostile units are coming in from all directions.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_trap_02: That is a good point, Ashley. However, I think it would be logical to assume that if they had any real power remaining, then they would take over this planet fairly quickly. The biggest risk that we are facing here is probably associated with activating dormant security systems.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_trap_04: Yes, that could theoretically become a problem. However, security systems are usually autonomous and self-contained. The risk of activating a self-replicating consciousness is close to zero. If you want to reduce this chance, then you should probably stop activating unknown artifacts.
dialog/encounters/mech_metallic_trap_05: I sometimes fail to understand why you were chosen to lead this mission.
dialog/encounters/mech_swamp_octopus_01: Ba careful, Ashley, we do not know if it is hostile or not.
dialog/encounters/mech_swamp_octopus_02: It does not appear to notice our presence. We should be safe here.
dialog/encounters/mech_swamp_octopus_03: I concur, Ashley. It looked dangerous because of its size, but it appears to be harmless.
dialog/encounters/mech_swamp_octopus_04: "Pleasure to me is wonder - the unexplored, the unexpected, the thing that is hidden and the changeless thing that lurks behind superficial mutability. To trace the remote in the immediate, the eternal in the ephemeral, the past in the present, the infinite in the finite, these are to me the springs of delight and beauty."
dialog/encounters/mech_swamp_stump_02: Maybe some other time, Ashley. We have enough to do above ground.
dialog/encounters/mech_swamp_stump_03: Look, over here, Ashley. Parabians. The same parasite species that infected The Great Mushroom Tree.
dialog/familiarity/ashley_cactus_pear_bl: Our sensors are indicating large quantities of Tanzanite within this plant. We can harvest this mineral directly from the plant.
Let's gather more samples of this plant to study how it manages to synthesize this mineral. It's our best lead.
Ok, let's do that as soon as we've secured our current objective.
Our sensors are indicating large quantities of Tanzanite within the cacti specimen.
A broader arsenal of weaponry could undoubtedly help us survive against all these new hostile creature species. Let's start researching Tanzanite Handling.
dialog/familiarity/ashley_crystal_entwin: This growth formation is very peculiar! It's a crystal entwined in very strong vines. It looks like this life form actually cultivates this crystal.

The magnetic field in this biome is acting completely strange. It is very fitting to see this mineral here. We should research these crystals further. Mr. Riggs, can you search for them using the Orbital Scanner?
Great job, Mr. Riggs. Let's jump there as soon as we're done here. I can't wait to see what we can craft with more Ferdonite.

The magnetic field in this biome is acting completely strange. It is very fitting to see this mineral here. We should definitely research these crystals further. This will allow us to gather more Ferdonite and create new equipment.

We've finished researching Ferdonite handling, the results are amazing. This mineral will allow us to craft entirely new equipment and weapons of extreme quality. The only problem is that we need to find more of this resource. Mr. Riggs, can you search for large condensations of the Entwined Ferdonite Crystals using the Orbital Scanner?
dialog/familiarity/ashley_crystal_pure_r: Amazing, these red crystals are really huge. Look at how the light is scattering below their surface. It's mesmerizing.
You already got me convinced at "lasers". We definitely need to learn more about these crystals. Can we search for them using the Orbital Scanner?
Excellent, let's go there as soon as we've secured the current objective.
You already had me convinced at "lasers". We definitely need to learn more about these crystals. We should research Rhodonite Handling as soon as possible.

We've finished researching Rhodonite handling. We can start researching new laser-based weapons and towers. They are going to be an excellent addition to our arsenal. However, we will first have to gather some Rhodonite to craft the new gear.
dialog/familiarity/ashley_gnerot_01: These rocks are moving. Whoa, these aren't rocks. It's a living creature.
dialog/familiarity/ashley_gnerot_02: Ok. We'll use explosives or energy weapons if we have to.
dialog/familiarity/ashley_magnetic_bould: Look at this object. It's enormous, and it just floats in the air like it doesn't weigh anything.
It looks alien, on an alien planet. Let's stay away from it. It reminds me of how I lost my arm.

The data that we've gathered about these strange magnetic rocks is fascinating. Their structure doesn't resemble anything that we've seen so far. They generate a strong electromagnetic field and can distort gravity. This shouldn't be possible.
We can't shatter them, but maybe we could dissolve them. A strong enough acid might do the trick.
dialog/familiarity/ashley_moltug_01: What? What did you say right now?
dialog/familiarity/ashley_moltug_02: Are you breaking down from the heat?
dialog/familiarity/ashley_moltug_03: What? Of course not. Someone screwed up your programming.
dialog/familiarity/ashley_moltug_04: Of course, you were. You're the best AI on this planet...
dialog/familiarity/ashley_mushroom_spiky: Interesting, it appears that this life form contains large amounts of Hazenite in crystallized form. If we could gather more samples of this species, we could learn how to obtain larger quantities of Hazenite to craft better equipment and weapons.
That's an excellent idea, Mr. Riggs. Our equipment sure could use an upgrade.

That was super fast. It looks like there is a lot of these plants, or mushrooms, or whatever we should call them nearby. We can work on proper categorization as soon as we study more samples of this species.

We've finished researching Hazenite handling. It is a fascinating mineral! The knowledge that we've gained will allow us to construct new high-energy weapons and much better armor. The only caveat is that we'll need to gather more of this mineral to actually craft some of these new toys.
dialog/familiarity/green_radioactive_cry: These green crystals are emitting a lot of gamma radiation. Try not to stand too close to them, or they will damage my armor.
dialog/familiarity/mech_cactus_pear_blue: We can use Tanzanite as a catalyst for production of high-energy weaponry and equipment. It would be great if we could gather larger quantities of this mineral to create something useful.
Ashley, I have already detected an interesting location with dense groups of these cacti. It is nearby, and we can jump there through the Orbital Scanner interface.

We have finished researching Tanzanite handling. We can start researching new weapons and equipment based on this mineral. However, please bear in mind that we will need to obtain this resource to craft these new inventions. The Purple Cacti, in which we originally discovered Tanzanite, could be a good lead.
dialog/familiarity/mech_crystal_entwined: This crystal contains a rare mineral called Ferdonite. It can be used for gravitational field manipulation when combined with a powerful magnetic field. It doesn't exist on Earth.
Roger that, Ashley. Orbital scanning in progress. This should not take long.
Orbital scanning finished. I have located a potentially Ferdonite rich location. The rift jump coordinates are marked on the Orbital Scanner interface.
Roger that, Ashley. I have located a potentially Ferdonite rich location. The rift jump coordinates are marked on the Orbital Scanner interface.
dialog/familiarity/mech_crystal_pure_red: They also contain a lot of Rhodonite. We can use this mineral to construct high-powered laser emitters for our weapons as well as other equipment.

These crystals are relatively common in this biome, however, I've detected an interesting location with a with a very high concentration of their growth. There should be a lot of Rhodonite in that area. I've marked the rift jump coordinates on the Orbital Scanner interface.

The red crystals that contain Rhodonite are relatively common in the Acidic Plains biome. However, I've detected an interesting location with a much above normal condensation of their growth. There should be a lot of Rhodonite in that area. I've marked the rift jump coordinates on the Orbital Scanner interface.
dialog/familiarity/mech_gnerot_01: Be careful Ashley, it's huge, and my power blade will only bounce off, just like regular bullets.
dialog/familiarity/mech_magnetic_boulder: It is emitting a powerful magnetic field. It is disrupting most of my equipment. We will not be able to construct any buildings within its immediate area of effect.
They are also impervious to all of our standard weapons and equipment. They are practically indestructible.
dialog/familiarity/mech_moltug_01: Ślimak, ślimak, co tu robisz? Taki ładny, taki tłusty, będzie z Ciebie wór kapusty.
dialog/familiarity/mech_moltug_04: My programming is impeccable. I was designed and perfected by some of the best programmers that humanity has ever seen.
dialog/familiarity/mech_mushroom_spiky_b: We can use the Orbital Scanner to search for larger populations of this life form. Their presence should lead us to larger quantities of Hazenite.
Orbital scanning finished. Potential Hazenite rich location detected. I have marked the rift jump coordinates on the Orbital Scanner Interface.
dialog/familiarity/stregaros_ashley_01: The Stregaros species is fascinating. Its carapace is built from an incredibly strong and light form of carbo-chitinous plating. It is perfect for these sandy deserts as it allows these creatures to move quickly over quicksand despite their mass. We've gathered enough samples to start researching new technology that will enable us to place special floor tiles over quicksand that will prevent our buildings from sinking.
dialog/generic/ashley_respawn_01: I'm back in one piece, but it was a close one. How are you doing Mr. Riggs?
dialog/generic/ashley_rift_jump_successf: Sensors online. Weapons activated. We're ready to go.
dialog/generic/ashley_start_drilling_01: Ok. Move onto the deposit and start drilling.
dialog/generic/ashley_treasure_found_02: Bingo! There's something hidden underground over here.
dialog/generic/ashley_treasure_found_03: Anomaly detected. Let's see what's buried here.
dialog/generic/ashley_warning_nest_wave_: Warning. A new group of hostile creatures is coming from a nearby nest.
Warning. Hostile creatures are coming from a nearby nest. We should go there and clear it out.
dialog/generic/houston_begin_field_base_: Roger that. Begin field base setup.
dialog/generic/houston_confirm_03: We're reading you loud and clear.
dialog/generic/houston_new_building_01: A new building is now available for construction.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_incoming_01: I'm detecting a large group of creatures heading towards our position.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_incoming_02: Warning! A large group of creatures is gathering near our base. Prepare for an incoming attack.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_incoming_03: Warning! An aggressive horde is amassing near our base. Prepare to defend our base.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_incoming_04: Warning! A hostile group of creatures is heading towards our base. Prepare for an incoming attack.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_incoming_05: Warning! An enemy attack is imminent. We should build stronger defenses around our base.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_incoming_06: Warning! Hostile creatures are closing in on our base. Prepare for an attack.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_start_01: Danger! Enemy creatures are closing in. Get ready to fight.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_start_02: Danger! Hostile creatures are approaching our base. Get ready for battle.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_start_03: Danger! A hostile swarm is moving in on our base. They are almost upon us.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_start_04: Danger! An enemy swarm is approaching our base. Brace for combat.
dialog/generic/mech_attack_start_05: Danger! An aggressive horde has entered the area. It is less than a minute away.
dialog/generic/mech_bioscanner_01: The Molecular Bioscanner tool is now online and fully operational. We can start gathering information about the local fauna and flora species.
dialog/generic/mech_death_01: My armor has been destroyed. Creating a rift back to base. Self-destruct in progress.
dialog/generic/mech_mission_area_expande: Mission area expanded. Please check your map.
The mission area has been expanded. Please check your map.
dialog/generic/mech_new_biome_01: A new biome is now available for survey with the Orbital Scanner.
dialog/generic/mech_orbital_scanner_cons: Orbital Scanner construction finished. We can now use it to Rift Jump to new locations by selecting new mission coordinates through the Orbital Scanner interface.
Orbital Scanner construction is in progress.
dialog/generic/mech_prime_rift_construct: Initiating construction of the Prime Rift Station.
dialog/generic/mech_respawn_01: I can't say I like being reconstructed, but at least I got fresh paint.
dialog/generic/mech_warning_nest_wave_sp: Warning. A new group of hostile creatures is coming from a nearby nest.
Warning. Hostile creatures are coming from a nearby nest. We should go there and clear it out.
dialog/objective/ashley_boss_encounter_0: We can't leave it roaming this area. Smaller creatures will gather around it, and they could overwhelm us. We have to eliminate it.
This is a big one. We have to kill it before it can gather a larger horde.
Shields up, Mr. Riggs. It looks like it's going to attack.
dialog/objective/ashley_boss_end_02: It was tougher than I expected. I hope they don't grow any bigger.
dialog/objective/ashley_boss_end_03: I'm sure it wasn't the last one. I think we can expect to meet even stronger ones.
dialog/objective/ashley_boss_end_04: Good. I was afraid it could gather a large horde in this area.
dialog/objective/ashley_boss_start_02: Roger that, Mr. Riggs. Omegas can be very dangerous, we should watch out for it.
dialog/objective/ashley_boss_start_03: Interesting. We should go to its location to learn more about it.
dialog/objective/ashley_boss_start_04: It could pose a serious threat to us. Let's go to it's location to see what it is.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_armory_01: And it will produce more ammunition for your guns. Yes, that is an important building.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_carbonium_: Yes, we've got much more interesting things to do. Let's automate this.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_comm_hub_0: Ok. Let's remember to build some additional power plants for it. It consumes a lot of energy.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_hq_01: We don't have enough carbonium to build an HQ. Let's scout for a deposit and set up our base close to it. We need to move quick. It's probably a matter of time before the natives spot us.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_hq_02: Finally. Let's place it close to a carbonium deposit. This will help us speed up resource production.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_outpost_01: It will also allow us to automatically transfer all of the resources that are mined in this location back to our HQ, even if we are not present in this location. We can construct a network of such outposts around the planet to build up our economy. It is the only way to acquire enough resources to construct the Rift Station and all of its components.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_power_plan: Wind Turbines are less effective, but they work around the clock. Carbonium Power Plants are very effective, but they use up the deposits that they are placed on.
dialog/objective/ashley_build_tower_ammo: We can also expand our ammunition reserves for both your guns and the towers by building ammunition storages.
dialog/objective/ashley_craft_items_01: That's a good idea. The enemy attacks are getting constantly stronger, we need better guns.
dialog/objective/ashley_creeper_encounte: I can see the root of the colony. We have to destroy it to stop further growth.
We've found the root of the colony. Focus all fire on the largest yeast cell in sight.
dialog/objective/ashley_creeper_end_01: This is it. We've destroyed the root of the colony. The rest should die on it's own.
dialog/objective/ashley_creeper_end_02: We've killed the root Mr. Riggs. The rest of the colony should die off on its own. We can get back to our primary objectives.
dialog/objective/ashley_creeper_start_01: That's bad news. We have to find and destroy the root of the colony to stop its growth.
dialog/objective/ashley_creeper_start_02: We have to find and destroy the root of that colony before it can reach our base. It's going to be harder to deal with, the longer we wait.
dialog/objective/ashley_harvest_encounte: Let's move in closer and harvest it for further investigation. Just be careful not to destroy it.
dialog/objective/ashley_harvest_start_01: Sounds interesting. Let's go and check what's causing this.
dialog/objective/ashley_kermon_attack_en: We've defeated the Kermon swarm. We have to make sure that we have some defenses around the entire base, there's no telling where they will attack next.
We've defeated those Kermons, but we have to watch out. They can be extremely dangerous.
dialog/objective/ashley_kill_boss_encoun: Kill it before it kills us. We'll finish researching it in the lab.
dialog/objective/ashley_kill_boss_end_01: I wonder what made it so aggressive. Maybe we can learn something important after researching it in a lab.
dialog/objective/ashley_kill_boss_start_: Sounds like an interesting research specimen. We should go to it's location and see what we can learn.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_encounter_0: There is a lot of them inside. This might be difficult!
Let's deal with this quickly. We can't let this infestation spread.
We have to destroy it to stop further attacks. Let's be quick about it.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_end_02: Good, that's one less thing to worry about.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_end_03: Ok, let's get back to our primary objectives.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_multiple_en: This looks like the last one of those nests. This should make them ease up a bit.
I think this was the last of these nests. I hope they don't return here too quickly.
It looks like we destroyed all of the nests in this area.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_multiple_st: If we don't do something about it then they will eventually overwhelm our base. Let's act quickly.
Roger that, Mr. Riggs. We have to destroy all of the hostile nests as soon as possible.
Understood. Let's go that area as soon as we can. The longer we wait the harder it's going to be to clear it out.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_start_01: Interesting. We should go and investigate that area.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_start_02: We should check that out. I'm marking that spot on our map.
dialog/objective/ashley_nest_start_03: Let's check that area as soon as possible. We don't want this to grow into something bigger.
dialog/objective/ashley_phirian_attack_e: The phirian attack is over. It's good they don't come in larger numbers.
dialog/objective/ashley_phirian_attack_s: Phirians are attacking our base. Quickly, we have to check our defenses!
dialog/objective/ashley_presence_detecte: There's probably a swarm of curious natives gathering to pay us a visit as we speak. It would be best to talk to them from behind some walls.
We have to assume that we're not welcome here. Remember to use repair kits if necessary.
dialog/objective/ashley_research_technol: We should start downloading new technologies as soon as possible. Our loadout for the rift jump included only some basic blueprints.
dialog/objective/ashley_scan_resources_e: This looks like a great spot to search for mineral fields near the surface.
dialog/objective/ashley_scan_resources_s: Ok. Let's go there and see what we can find.
dialog/objective/ashley_seismic_scanner_: Yes, that's a very good idea. It will allow us to search for anomalies hidden beneath the ground like new resource deposits, rare mineral fields or any other surprises that this planet might be hiding from us.
It reminds me of playing hot'n cold as a kid. Ok Mr Riggs, let's go treasure hunting.
dialog/objective/ashley_shegret_attack_e: Good. Let's check if our power supply is still intact.
Roger that, Mr. Riggs. Lets hope they don't surprise us too often.
Ok. Lets place a few more lamps where they attacked us. I think they are scared of strong light sources.
dialog/objective/ashley_shegret_attack_s: Shegrets! We have to kill them before they drain our energy supplies.
It's a Shegret attack! We have to hunt them down in our base.
It's a Shegret swarm! We have to protect the energy grid, or they'll suck out all of our power!
dialog/objective/ashley_shegret_first_en: Our energy emissions clearly drew these creatures. They ignored our defenses and went straight for the power grid as if they were mad. I think they also tried to avoid the light from our base. That was a very strange encounter.
If their attacks are more frequent, then they can cause some disruptions, but I don't think they could be a significant threat on their own.
Let's call them Shegrets. They remind me of the electro worms that I've seen on Orion.
What? What's going on? Where is this movement heading?
They're leeching out energy directly from the power grid. We have to kill all of them before it's too late.
dialog/objective/ashley_upgrade_hq_01: These creatures are clearly drawn to our energy emissions. So it will be like an alarm bell for them. We should strenghten our defenses before upgrading the HQ
dialog/objective/ashley_upgrade_hq_02: We should reinforce our defenses as much as we can. Things are going to get very hot very soon.
dialog/objective/ashley_upgrade_hq_03: We've made all the preparations that we could. Let's go out and meet them!
dialog/objective/ashley_upgrade_hq_04: This will buy us some time until the next attack. Let's check what's new after the HQ upgrade.
dialog/objective/ashley_upgrade_hq_final: We're ready. The final Rift back to Earth is powering up. As soon as it's open we'll be able to go back home. There might even be some cake waiting there for us. The Rift is going to send out strong energy waves in a large distance. This is going to stir up every creature within running distance of our base. We have to prepare for the strongest attack yet.
I guess we've made all the preparations that we could. Let's see how our base stands against this horde!
I can't believe it. We've made it through. Now, let's go and check if there's still some cake left for us.
dialog/objective/ashley_upgrade_hq_gener: We have some time before the attack. Let's strengthen our defenses.
dialog/objective/mech_ai_hub_tutorial_01: We don't have enough AI Cores to support any more defensive towers. You will need to construct additional AI Hubs to expand our defenses. Remember to build more power plants before you do that. AI Hubs consume a lot of energy.
dialog/objective/mech_boss_encounter_02: This is the Omega-class creature that we detected earlier. Extreme caution is advised.
dialog/objective/mech_boss_encounter_03: We have visual confirmation of an Omega-class creature, Ashley.
dialog/objective/mech_boss_encounter_04: Omega-class creature located. Be careful, Ashley.
dialog/objective/mech_boss_end_03: Objective complete, Ashley. The Omega-class creature has been neutralized.
dialog/objective/mech_boss_start_02: Ashley, my sensors have picked up an Omega-class creature nearby.
dialog/objective/mech_boss_start_03: Warning, an Omega-class creature has been detected near our position.
dialog/objective/mech_build_armory_01: Ashley, I strongly advise you to construct an Armory. It will allow us to craft new weapons and upgrades and also manufacture field repair kits as well as other usable items.
dialog/objective/mech_build_armory_02: Armory contruction finished. We can now use it to craft new items. It will also automatically manufacture ammunition for my weapons.
dialog/objective/mech_build_armory_03: Now that you've crafted some new equipment don't forget to change my loadout and weapon configuration.
dialog/objective/mech_build_carbonium_fa: We need to expand the base. Let's build a Carbonium Factory to do the digging for us.
Ashley. We really need that Carbonium Factory.
dialog/objective/mech_build_comm_hub_01: We should start downloading new blueprints so we can construct more advanced buildings and items. Build a Communications Hub as soon as possible.
dialog/objective/mech_build_comm_hub_02: Communications Hub contruction finished. We can now use it to download new technologies.
dialog/objective/mech_build_comm_hub_03: The improved Headquarters building can support more Communication Hubs. If we want to download new technologies faster, then we should construct as many of them as possible.
dialog/objective/mech_build_hq_01: Ashley, construct a Headquarters building to secure our presence here. It will allow me to reconstruct if my armor is destroyed.
dialog/objective/mech_build_hq_02: We've gathered enough resources to construct a Headquarters building.
dialog/objective/mech_build_outpost_01: Outpost construction in progress. This building is a local version of our Headquarters. It will allow me to reconstruct whenever I am destroyed, and it has a permanent rift station that we can rift jump to at any time.
dialog/objective/mech_build_outpost_02: Be mindful of where we place these buildings, though. Our Headquarters have a capacity limit of how many outposts we can support at once, so whenever there is no use for an outpost, we should deconstruct it and recycle the resources that were used to build it.
dialog/objective/mech_build_power_plant_: Our base will require huge amounts of power to operate. Right now we can only construct some basic power plants - Wind Turbines and Carbonium Power Plants.

In the beginning it's best to use a combination of these power sources. We can balance energy peaks and shortages by storing excess energy in Energy Storages. Also remember to connect all buildings to the power grid using Energy Connectors. They connect all buildings within their area of operation, even if power lines are not visible.
Ashley. Remember to connect all buildings to the power grid. Energy Connectors distribute power to all buildings within their operating radius.
We are low on energy! Build additional power plants and connect them to the power grid.
dialog/objective/mech_build_tower_ammo_f: These towers can not shoot without ammunition. Build a Tower Ammo Factory to start producing ammunition.
dialog/objective/mech_craft_items_01: Ashley, now that the Armory is operational we can craft some new weapons.
dialog/objective/mech_creeper_encounter_: The root of the colony is nearby. Ashley, focus on destroying the central cell, and the rest of the colony will wither and die.
Acidic yeast colony root detected. Destroy that central cell to stop the colony's growth.
dialog/objective/mech_creeper_end_01: Objective complete. The root of the colony has been destroyed. Acidic yeast growth has been halted.
dialog/objective/mech_creeper_end_02: Ashley, I confirm that the root of the acidic yeast colony is dead. The remaining cells should die on their own.
dialog/objective/mech_creeper_start_01: Warning! A dangerous Acidic Yeast Colony has been detected nearby. Its growth vector is threatening.
dialog/objective/mech_creeper_start_02: Ashley, I have detected a growing Acidic Yeast Colony. It is spreading towards our base.
dialog/objective/mech_harvest_encounter_: It looks like this plant is the source of the strange energy emissions.
dialog/objective/mech_harvest_start_01: I'm receiving very strange readings from a location close to our base.
dialog/objective/mech_kermon_attack_end_: We have defended against the Kermon attack. Please verify base integrity.
Kermon attack defeated. Please note that future attacks may be stronger and reinforce our defenses accordingly.
dialog/objective/mech_kermon_attack_star: Danger! My sensors are picking up cloaked units moving toward our base. They can attack from any direction.
Danger! Cloaked units are approaching the base perimeter. They will not be visible on radar until they attack.
dialog/objective/mech_kill_boss_encounte: This creature is extremely hostile. It can be dangerous to our base.
dialog/objective/mech_kill_boss_start_01: I've detected an unusually large create roaming the nearby area.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_encounter_01: This looks like a nest of some sort. We should clear it out and reduce the strength of hostile attacks.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_encounter_02: This is a hostile nest, Ashley. We have to destroy it to stop these creatures from attacking us.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_encounter_03: Warning. We are approaching a large nest. Expect hostile creatures around it.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_end_01: This should stop them from gathering in this area and improve our chances of survival.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_end_03: Objective complete, Ashley. This will stop the attacks from this area.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_multiple_end_: Affirmative. I'm not detecting any more nests within scannable range.
Good job, Ashley. We can return to our primariy objectives now.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_multiple_star: Ashley. There's a large hostile infestation nearby. These creatures are concentrating around a few nests which pose a serious threat to our base. We should go out and clear them out.

My sensors are picking up a large infestation close to our position. Hostile creatures are amassing quickly in that area and are going to start attacking us soon. We should focus on eliminating that threat as soon as possible.
Warning. I have detected a large hostile infestation near our position. Expect continuous enemy attacks until we clear it out.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_start_01: It looks like some of these creatures' attacks are originating from a common point near our base.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_start_02: I have detected an unusual concentration of creatures near our position. That might be a hostile nest.
dialog/objective/mech_nest_start_03: Ashley, my sensors are picking up a lot of movement around a certain point near our location. That could be a hostile nest.
dialog/objective/mech_phirian_attack_end: We have defended against the phirian attack. We should verify any damage done to our base.
dialog/objective/mech_phirian_attack_sta: Danger! A phirian swarm is attacking our base from multiple directions.
dialog/objective/mech_presence_detected_: Ashley. I'm sure that our presence will not go unnoticed. We should build up our base as quickly as possible.
I'm detecting a large group of creatures heading towards our position. It looks like our presence has been noticed.
dialog/objective/mech_research_technolog: The Communications Hub is operational. We can use it to download new technologies.
dialog/objective/mech_scan_resources_enc: Ashley. Deploy the sensor tool to scan for objects hidden underneath the ground.
dialog/objective/mech_scan_resources_end: Ok. Let's move over there and start drilling.
dialog/objective/mech_scan_resources_sta: Our sensors have detected a possible location for a rare mineral deposit.
dialog/objective/mech_seismic_scanner_tu: Ashley, now that the Armory is operational we can construct the Seismic Scanner.
The Seismic Scanner is ready for use. You can equip it into any of my arms, just like a weapon. It will pulse more quickly the closer we are to a seismic anomaly.
dialog/objective/mech_shegret_attack_end: Threat eliminated. I am not detecting any suspicious movement below or above ground.
Shegret swarm eliminated. I am not detecting any more movement underground.
We have cleared out all of the Shegrets from the base permimiter.
dialog/objective/mech_shegret_attack_sta: Warning. My scanners are picking up movement underground.
I am picking up abnormal activity underground. Ashley, something is moving towrads our base.
Ashley, I am picking up multiple objects moving underground. They are heading straight for our base.
dialog/objective/mech_shegret_first_enco: Threat eliminated. I am not detecting any suspicious movement below or above ground. That attack was something new. What do you think, Ashley?
Can this species pose a significant threat to our presence on Galatea 37?
How would you like to call this species?
Ashley, I am detecting movement underground. This is very unusual.
Warning! Hostile creatures are appearing within our base. Significant energy drain detected.
dialog/objective/mech_upgrade_hq_01: It looks like we have the base up and running. If you'd like to construct more advanced buildings you'll have to upgrade the Headquarters building. Unfortunately this process also emits a lot of high frequency energy waves...
dialog/objective/mech_upgrade_hq_02: Headquarters upgrade in progress. This will attract a lot of attention.
dialog/objective/mech_upgrade_hq_03: I can sense the ground shaking. I estimate a few hundred creatures running at our base. They are very close. Prepare yourself Ashley.
dialog/objective/mech_upgrade_hq_final_0: I can sense the ground shaking. I estimate a few thousand creatures running at our base. They are very close. Prepare yourself Ashley.
The Rift back to Earth is stabilizing. Hostile creature count has been minimized. Ashley, prepare for the trip back home.
dialog/objective/mech_upgrade_hq_generic: My sensors are picking up multiple groups of hostile creatures approaching our base.
Headquarters upgrade in progress. This will attract a lot of attention.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_find_new_resour: It's actually quite calm in here. That's a bit suspicious, don't you think, Mr. Riggs?
Great, the ones we've been finding so far were really small. Maybe we can find something that we could place an automated mining station on.

The Palladium deposits that we've been finding here are too small to build a mining station. However, we've learned how to find it. The data gathered with the Geoscanner can be fed to the Orbital Scanner to search for minable Palladium. Our mission here is complete. We can return to headquarters to start preparing to build a Palladium mining outpost.

What's this!? The Geoscanner detected a hidden cache of explosive fluid underground. This functionality is normally used for detecting minefields. There are exploding mushrooms underground. This must be the reason why the acidic yeast colonies are not present in this area. Let's be careful here!

A giant mushroom just exploded under our feet! I didn't expect that. We can use the Geoscanner to detect hidden explosives underground. This functionality is normally used for detecting minefields, but we can use it here as well. This must be the reason why the acidic yeast colonies are not present in this area. Let's be careful here!
dialog/story/acid/ashley_find_rare_resou: Ok, let's grab the Geoscanner and start searching for treasure.
We've gathered enough crystal samples to start researching Rhodonite handling. This is going to unlock a lot of new technologies.
Excellent, we should gather as much Rhodonite as possible. We'll use it later to craft better equipment,
We've gathered a sizeable amount of Rhodonite. This should be enough to craft some good equipment. We can stay here and try to find even more or get back to our primary objectives.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_find_samples_01: Good, we need to get close to the central root of one of these colonies and construct a Research Station near it. This isn't going to be easy.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_find_samples_02: Ok, this looks like the central root of the colony. Now we have to build a Research Station close to it to start the scanning procedure.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_find_samples_03: Great, now we just have to maintain power to the Research Lab and let it gather the necessary data.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_find_samples_04: We're halfway through analyzing the root of the acidic yeast colony. The data is already looking very promising.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_find_samples_05: That's very interesting. It looks like we've been recognized as a threat, the colonies are trying to devour our base.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_resource_outpos: Ok, let's look for an easily defendable position near a Palladium deposit, and remember to build our base on anti-corrosive floor tiles. This biome is not going to give up its resources easily.
That could adversely change the ecological balance of this biome. Let's treat that option as a last resort.
Rare element mines consume a lot of power. There's a natural abundance of refinable sludge in this biome. We can easily power our base with Gas Power plants.

The attacks against our outpost are increasing in strength and numbers. We should build up more advanced defensive towers to protect our base. Acidic yeast is also creeping up from all directions. This area is very rich in resources, so we can establish additional mining bases if we need to expand our economy.

The mining operation must have disturbed a lot of them. We are going to need advanced defense towers to repel these creatures. Also, let's not forget about setting up minefields on the critical paths towards our outpost.
We've defended our outpost against hordes of acid-spitting monsters, giant snails, underground death beetles, and all-devouring yeast. I call it a day...

That is an excellent idea. This outpost will remain here as a permanent base of operations. We can even build up more mines and factories here to boost our economy. All of the resources that are produced here will be automatically transferred to our HQ as long as the Orbital Scanner is operational. Long-distance rift travel and resource transportation are not possible without it.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_scout_01: Fluoric acid condensation is definitely abnormal comparing to what we've seen in other parts of the planet. Something must be emitting the acid straight into the air. Let's look around to see what we can find.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_scout_02: Ok, let's go there to see what is causing them.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_scout_03: The acidic fumes are much denser near this growth. This thing must be responsible for the highly corrosive atmosphere in this area.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_scout_04: There must be much more of this acidic yeast growing here. The Orbital Scanner report indicated that this entire biome is covered in these fumes. We should study it further before setting up a permanent outpost in this area of the planet.
dialog/story/acid/ashley_scout_05: Ok, that's enough samples to start researching them in the Alien Research Lab.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_new_resource: Rift jump successful. Orbital scanning indicated that there should be multiple underground Palladium deposits hidden in this area. We can use the Geoscanner to find them.
Yes, that is abnormal. I'm not detecting any acidic yeast colonies in the area. The local fauna population also seems to be smaller than in the other areas of this biome.
Ashley, I have located a larger underground Palladium deposit. I have marked its location on our map.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_rare_resourc: Rift jump successful. The Orbital Scanner reported large condensations of Rhodonite in this area, both underground and in the form of the red crystal formations that we've seen in the other parts of this biome.
You can also use the Bioscanner to scan the red crystal formations. If we can gather enough samples of these crystals, we will learn how to obtain more Rhodonite.
Ashley, I have located a large condensation of Rhodonite near our position. I have marked its approximate location on our map.
Warning! Multiple Granan nests detected within this area. Be careful, Ashley!

Ashley, my resource extraction AI subroutines have gathered enough data about these red crystals to start extracting Rhodonite directly from them. If we could collect even more specimens, then maybe we could even grow them using a Cultivator.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_samples_01: Rift jump successful. I am detecting multiple acidic yeast colonies nearby. They are larger than the ones we have seen before and are growing at a faster rate.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_samples_02: I have located an acidic yeast colony root nearby. You can check its location on the map.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_samples_03: Remember that we can block the growth of the colony by placing anti-corrosive floor tiles around it. It would be advised to build our entire base on anti-corrosive floor.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_samples_04: Research Lab operational. Acidic yeast scanning in progress.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_samples_05: My sensors are picking up increased movement around our position. We should prepare to defend the Research Laboratory.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_samples_06: Ashley, since you've built up our Research Station in this area, I've noticed a change in the growth vector of the acidic yeast colonies around us. It appears that all of them are slowly growing in our direction.
dialog/story/acid/mech_find_samples_07: The Research Lab has finished gathering data. Objective completed, we can return to Headquarters.
dialog/story/acid/mech_resource_outpost_: Rift jump successful. Orbital scanning was correct. I am detecting multiple rich Palladium deposits nearby. Warning! Acidic yeast activity is very high in this area.
Once we establish a permanent outpost, we could also try to destroy the roots of the acidic yeast colonies. That should stop them from spreading further.
Outpost construction finished. We should construct rare element mines on the Palladium deposits near our base, and start mining this resource.
That is a good idea. Also do not forget to secure our outpost with advanced defense towers. Setting up a few Radars would also be a good idea. They can monitor the growth of acidic yeast colonies.
We have mined half of the Palladium that we need to finish constructing the Hyper Particle Condenser for the Rift Station. I am detecting increased activity amongst the local fauna.

Warning! I'm detecting a massive swarm of creatures heading towards our outpost. We still have some time to prepare. Strengthen our defenses as much as possible. This attack is going to be very strong.
I'm not detecting any large groups of creatures in the vicinity of our base. We fended off the attack.
Ashley, we have gathered enough Palladium to construct the Hyper Particle Condenser. We should return to HQ to start the construction process.
dialog/story/acid/mech_scout_01: Rift jump successful. Environmental scanning in progress. Ashley, my sensors are indicating a highly acidic atmosphere composition.
dialog/story/acid/mech_scout_02: I am picking up acidic fume emissions near our position.
dialog/story/acid/mech_scout_03: This life form is multiplying very rapidly. It is subdividing its cells similarly to Earth-based yeast. The fluid inside these cells is highly corrosive. Please keep a safe distance.
dialog/story/acid/mech_scout_04: Ashley, I strongly suggest using a Bioscanner to gather samples from these life forms. The fluid inside them is a highly condensed acid that can easily burn through my armor. The Bioscanner will allow us to gather samples from a safe distance.
dialog/story/acid/mech_scout_05: I am not detecting any traces of Palladium or any other objects of interest in this area. We can return to Headquarters and continue scanning the planet for traces of Palladium.
dialog/story/campaign/ashley_ice_biome_u: Oh, that might be a more friendly biome to visit than the Acidic Plains. Did you find any particular location that we should scout there?
dialog/story/campaign/ashley_orbital_sca: Interesting, we've found traces of Palladium inside the acidic yeast samples that we just collected. It might be a good idea to search for larger colonies of this life form. They might indicate the location of higher concentrations of Palladium.

The acidic yeast colonies that we've observed seemed to grow from a central root inside the colony. I'd like to study a living colony in its natural habitat to gather more data on how it gathers Palladium from the environment. We'll need to construct a local Reasearch Station near one of the colonies in order to do that. We'll have to download the necessary technology for that building if we don't have it yet.
I think that we can prevent the colony from overgrowing our base by covering the soil with a structure that the acidic yeast can't grow on.

We can prevent that. Now that we know the type of acid that this life form is producing, we can research special, anti-corrosive flooring that will protect our base. We just need to build the Research Station on the anti-corrosive floor tiles.

The data that we've gathered proves that this life form can digest even the smallest traces of Palladium. Palladium normally doesn't react with most acids, but this life form uses a highly concentrated form of fluoric acid that is heated up by the creature's metabolic processes. We can program the Orbital Scanner to analyze the growth patterns of the acidic yeast colonies. This should help us in finding Palladium deposits that these colonies are moving towards.
Interesting, if there's Palladium there and they aren't interested in it, then something might be preventing them from growing in that area. We should prepare for the unexpected.
