That's good. Maybe there will be fewer exploding mushrooms in that area. Either way, we should remember to use the Geoscanner frequently.
Gaining access to Uranium would allow us to construct nuclear power plants and some heavy weaponry. This should make surviving on Galatea much easier.

Mr. Riggs, I think that we can use the natural background radiation data that we've just gathered to filter out the naturally occurring radiation within the desert biome. We can use the Orbital Scanner to search for even higher condensations of radiation to pinpoint a possible location for extracting nuclear fuel necessary to finish constructing the Rift Station.
Excellent, we should go there as soon as possible. It would also be good to have that Radiation Shielding research finished before going on that mission.
That's excellent news, Mr. Riggs. Let's go there to set up a Uranium mining outpost. We'll finally have access to Nuclear Power and better weaponry.
All of these locations contain extreme environmental hazards and unknown species of creatures. We should upgrade our equipment as much as we can before venturing out into these new biomes.

Acknowledged, Mr. Riggs. We will finally be able to gather larger amounts of Titanium to start producing better equipment and finish the Rift Station construction. Let's go there to establish a Titanium Mining Outpost as soon as possible.
dialog/story/campaign/mech_ice_biome_unl: Ashley, I have made an interesting discovery. Orbital Scanner data suggests that we could find rich Palladium deposits in Galatea's northern Cryo Fields.
No, but you can search for promising mission areas within the northern Cryo Fields biome directly through the Orbital Scanner Interface.
dialog/story/campaign/mech_orbital_scann: The second interesting area is densely covered by acidic clouds of unknown origin. Spectral analysis detected traces of Palladium scattered throughout this geographical zone. I have marked a safe rift jump location for initial reconnaissance on the Orbital Scanner interface.

Orbital scanning completed. We have located a large colony of acidic yeast. I have marked the rift jump coordinates on the Planetary Scanner interface. Warning! It is recommended to develop Acidic Shielding before visiting that location. It is going to be difficult to survive there without it.

Ashley, I am afraid that the Research Station will not be able to scan the colony from a safe distance. It would have to be placed very close to the root of the colony to work properly. We will not be able to build anything that close to the root without being overwhelmed by its growth, especially given the fact that we do not want to destroy it.
Standard floor tiles are going to be corroded by the colony.
Affirmative Ashley. Orbital scanning in progress, analyzing acidic yeast growth patterns. This will take some time.
Orbital scanning finished. We have calculated rift jump coordinates for a potentially Palladium-rich location. Acidic yeast colonies are growing everywhere around this area.

Understood, Ashley. I am starting the Orbital scanning procedure and searching for mineable Palladium deposits. In the meantime we should research Palladium Handling technology to be able to actually construct Palladium mining stations.
Orbital scanning finished. We have calculated a favorable location for a Palladium mining outpost. I am detecting multiple acidic yeast colonies in this area.
Affirmitive Ashley. Orbital Scanning in progress, targeting acidic yeast colonies.
The Research Lab has finished gathering data. Objective completed.
Affirmative Ashley. Orbital scanning in progress, analyzing acidic yeast growth patterns...

Orbital scanning finished. We have found something interesting. There are a few areas within the Acidic Plains that are entirely surrounded by the yeast colonies. Spectral analysis confirms that Palladium should be present there, however, the yeast is actively avoiding these zones.

One of Galatea's continents appears to be a barren desert that has been scorched by intense radiation and very intense solar activity. These harsh conditions are most probably caused by the high condensation of radioactive elements like Uranium or thorium. Our scans have located a safe rift jump location for an initial scouting mission.
Affirmative Ashley. We should have some results available shortly.

Orbital scanning completed. Ashley, we've detected a new area within the desert biome that can potentially contain higher condensations or radioactive elements. I have marked its location on the Orbital Scanner interface.
Orbital scanning in progress. We should have a good location for a mining outpost soon.
Orbital scanning finished. We've located rich Uranium deposits in a new planetary location. I have marked the rift jump coordinates on the Orbital Scanner interface.
Orbital Scanner geomapping procedure finished. We have gathered a lot of very useful information about the planet and found traces of rare elements in multiple locations around the globe.
The planetary geomapping procedure is in progress. Calculating coordinates for possible rift jump locations. The process will soon be completed.
Orbital scanning in progress. Searching for traces of Titanium within the planet's volcanic zone. This will take some time to complete.

Orbital scanning finished. We've located a new planetary location with larger underground Titanium deposits. Warning! The volcanoes in that area are very active. Make sure to equip any armor enhancements that we have available before going there.
Orbital scanning in progress. We should have a good location for a Titanium mining outpost soon.
Orbital scanning finished. We have located rich Titanium deposits in a new planetary location. I have marked the rift jump coordinates on the Orbital Scanner interface.

Titanium has been detected in a large zone of intense volcanic activity. The Orbital Scanner has been providing some strange readings from this area, with temperatures ranging from eight hundred to one hundred degrees Kelvin. On top of that, it is entirely impossible to get any sensible magnetic field readings from this area. We were able to find a safe rift jump location within the volcanic zone. However, you should expect extreme environmental conditions.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_find_new_reso: Good. This means that we are really onto something. I don't expect to find Uranium rods lying around. Let's use the Geoscanner to search for some ore.
We won't be getting any good results by searching for Uranium this way. This is tedious.
There's a lot of creatures around this area. We won't be getting to that Uranium without a fight.
Thank you for the advice, Mr. Riggs. That's very helpful...

Ok, we've gathered enough Uranium samples. We have to search for larger Uranium Ore deposits that could be mined autonomously. Now that we know the type of Uranium Ore that is present in this area, we should download the appropriate Uranium Handling technology to be ready to set up a mining outpost.
It's like following a bread crumb trail, but I feel that we're getting closer.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_find_rare_res: Interesting. We've actually found an oasis in this desert. It looks like one of those condensations is around a pool of liquid. We have to see this.
Ok, we'll analyze it with the Geoscanner as soon as we get there.
Wow, this is an actual oasis. It looks stunning. These cacti are growing like crazy near this pond.

These cacti clearly like to grow in this place. They condense the Tanzanite from the soil during their growth process. Unfortunately, these ones are too small to harvest any meaningful quantities of the resource.

Mr Riggs, I think I know how we can extract the underground Tanzanite deposit. We can use the water from the oasis to power a Cultivator. If we can build a pipeline from the oasis to the underground deposit then we could speed up the growth of the cacti in that area. These plants will extract the Tanzanite for us.
Ok. We can harvest these cacti manually or we can automate the process by constructing additional Harvesting Stations.
Excellent. We can craft some really good weaponry with this amount of Tanzanite.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_find_samples_: This Stregaros breeding area is located in a narrow, rocky valley. Its layout works like a large wind tunnel and creates an almost constant dust storm.

Yes, the Bioscanner is going to be much better than any weapon here. We can use it to scan these creatures from afar without making them aggressive. It is also much quicker at finding good research samples.
Interesting, maybe that is the real reason why there are so many of these creatures in this area. Let's investigate this.
This huge crystal is the source of the magnetic anomaly. Let's get close to it to gather samples.

This crystal behaves in a very strange way. It emits a lot of high-frequency electromagnetic waves, they have a distinct regularity, almost as if a song was playing that's not meant for our ears. Let's research these samples in our lab.
Oh no, the crystal is destroyed.
We definitely shouldn't have done that.
We've survived that, but I have a feeling that this is going to have consequences.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_resource_outp: Excellent, let's scout the area to find a good location to construct a permanent Outpost. We should look for a site that's close to a Uranium deposit and is easily defendable.

Our presence isn't welcome here. These creatures know we're here, and I'm sure that it's just a matter of time before they start attacking our outpost. We should build up defenses as soon as possible. These small antlike Mushbits are very fast and very aggressive, they attack in dense swarms, so it would probably be best to set up some flame towers against them. Our Sentinel Towers also won't be any good against the larger creatures like Stregaros or Gnerots. We should set up some Artillery or Plasma towers against them. It's not going to be easy to survive here.
Ok. Uranium Ore mining is underway. Now we need to start processing the ore to create enriched Uranium. We'll need to place a few Uranium Centrifuges to get this running at a reasonable rate.
That's a good idea. We need to remember to construct an adequate number of Energy Storage buildings to survive through the night while solar panels are not operational.
We're halfway through gathering enough Uranium to construct the Fusion Field Accelerator for The Rift Station.

The mining operation must have disturbed a lot of them. We are going to need advanced defense towers to repel these creatures. Also, let's not forget about setting up minefields on the critical paths towards our outpost.

That was intense. Our jungle headquarters feel really cozy compared to this place... We've gathered enough Uranium to construct the Fusion Field Accelerator. Let's return to HQ to start the construction process.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_scout_01: The natural background radiation in this area is very high. It would kill most living organisms from Earth.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_scout_02: The protective atmosphere is also very thin in this area. UV radiation from the sun could pose a real threat. No wonder this area looks like a desert. We'll have to improve environmental shielding on our structures before setting up a larger outpost in this area.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_scout_03: Ok. Let's try to scout as much area as possible to feed your sensors with enough data.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_scout_04: We should research these technologies before venturing further into this biome. The creatures in this desert are very dangerous on their own, so it would be nice to worry less about the environment itself.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_stregaros_enc: Fascinating. Look at this creature. It has a very dense and thick carapace, yet it moves very swiftly over sand. We should study this species further.
Let's pass this creature's characteristics to the Orbital Scanner and look for a location where we can find more of them.
dialog/story/desert/ashley_stregaros_fin: That sounds very interesting. The creatures in this biome are unlike anything that we've seen before. Let's go to its suggested location and try to learn more about it.
dialog/story/desert/mech_build_on_sand_0: Ashley, you've placed this structure on quicksand. It is going to slowly sink into the sand. We should place Extra Stable Floor tiles over quicksand to prevent sinking.
Ashley, you've placed this structure on quicksand. It is going to slowly sink into the sand. We should research Extra Stable Floor tiles so we can place them over quicksand to prevent sinking.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_new_resour: Rift jump successful. I am detecting very high background radiation in this area. It is dangerously close to the safety limit of my armor.
Ashley. This is our lucky day. My sensors are picking up a larger underground Uranium deposit. I've marked it on our map.
You can search for Uranium elsewhere, but that's probably going to take more time. You can fight these creatures, or you can try to figure out a different solution.
Ashley, we can use the radiation signature of the Uranium ore that we've gathered to calibrate the Orbital Scanner to search for more significant deposits.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_rare_resou: Rift jump successful. This area is very rich in Tanzanite. My scans have indicated two especially large condensations nearby. I have marked their locations on our minimap.
Yes, that is odd indeed. The second location appears to be a bit more standard. It is a large Tanzanite deposit hidden underground. It is spread out in a larger radius.
They contain a lot of Tanzanite. We can harvest them to gather the resource as well as research samples.
Ashley, there's a lot of Tanzanite in this area, but its concentration is so low that I will not be able to excavate it with my equipment.
Good thinking, Ashley. The pipeline is going to be long, but it will work if we can put it together. The Mushbit colonies in the area will not make this easy.
The Cultivator is operational. It will require some time to grow these cacti to appropriate size.
Do not forget about setting up some defenses for our little outpost here. It is almost certain that we will come under attack as soon as the local fauna learns about our presence.
We have gathered enough Tanzanite to start crafting new equipment. Ashley, we can stay here and search for more minerals, or we can return to our primary objectives.

We could harvest Tanaznite directly from the purple cacti that grow in this area if I could familiarize my resource extraction AI subroutines with this species. We can gather research specimens very effectively with the Bioscanner.
Ashley, my resource extraction AI subroutines have finished familiarizing themselves with this purple cacti species. We can now extract Tanzanite directly from these plants.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_samples_01: Rift jump successful. Dust storm incoming. Prepare for severe visibility reduction.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_samples_02: It is going to be difficult to fight these creatures in these conditions. We can gather research samples in a more effective way using the Bioscanner.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_samples_03: Ashley, I'm picking up a magnetic anomaly nearby. It might be worth investigating that area.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_samples_04: Be careful, Ashley. It looks fragile.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_samples_06: Warning! I'm detecting a lot of movement heading our way.
dialog/story/desert/mech_find_samples_07: I'm not detecting any more points of interest in this area. We can rift jump back to base as soon as you are ready.
dialog/story/desert/mech_resource_outpos: Rift jump successful. Ashley, our long-range scans were correct. I'm detecting multiple Uranium deposits that are large enough to be mined.
This area has a very rich geological composition. I am detecting multiple Ironium and Carbonium deposits. We can mine them as well to improve our economy.
As soon as we are done securing this area, we should start mining Uranium.

Uranium Centrifuges require a lot of energy to operate. We can take advantage of the increased efficiency of solar panels in this biome. We could already start building Nuclear Powerplants, but there's no water to cool the reactors in this biome.
Ashley, you can accelerate the process by securing additional Uranium deposits and building more Uranium Centrifuges.

Warning! I'm detecting a massive swarm of creatures heading towards our outpost. We still have some time to prepare. Strengthen our defenses as much as possible. This attack is going to be very strong.
I'm not detecting any large groups of creatures in the vicinity of our base. We fended off the attack.

Remember that this outpost will remain as a permanent base of operations. We can expand the number of resource mines that are operational in this area to boost our economy. All of the resources produced here will be automatically transferred to our HQ as long as the Orbital Scanner is active. Long-distance rift travel and transportation are not possible without it.
dialog/story/desert/mech_scout_01: Rift jump successful. Environmental scanning in progress...
dialog/story/desert/mech_scout_02: My standard radiation shielding can withstand these levels of exposure without any damage. However, if the background radiation is so high in this area, then we can expect much more intense sources of gamma particles. These could pose a serious threat.
dialog/story/desert/mech_scout_03: Ashley, we should gather more data about this area. We can later use the readings from my sensors to develop improved radiation and UV shielding for both my armor and our structures.
dialog/story/desert/mech_scout_04: Environmental scanning completed. We've gathered enough data to start developing Advanced UV Shielding and Radiation Shielding in the Alien Laboratory.
dialog/story/desert/mech_stregaros_encou: I can sense a few of these creatures in this area, but this won't be enough to gather samples for research.
Orbital scanning completed. We've found a location that looks like a breeding ground for the Stregaros species. We can go there to study it further.
dialog/story/desert/mech_stregaros_find_: Ashley, I'm detecting a new species of creatures that have very unusual movement characteristics.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_arcology_ass: We did it, Mr. Riggs. This is not just a structure, it is proof that colonization can be done in a better way. We built a city that's going to breathe with the planet.
We are finally free, Mr. Riggs. I feel that we can return to Earth holding our heads high.
A truly magnificent sight to behold. This is the gateway to technology led cohabitation on Galatea 37.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_arcology_pre: That building is different from the other Megastructures. It requires even more resources than the previous ones, but thanks to the advancements that we have already made, we can build it in a single step. It is going to serve as a working platform for the construction of the first Arcology. We'll be ready to start working on that project as soon as the foundation is complete.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_arcology_sta: We are finally here, Mr. Riggs. This is the heart of everything we have been working toward. With the Arcology Workshop operational, we can finally start building the first Arcology directly in the planet's orbit.

That's why we built the Gravitational Hyper Lens. It's powerful enough to keep the entire structure in orbit. We just need to ensure that it remains operational throughout the entire assembly process. Otherwise, construction will halt.

The Hydroponic Sustainability Lab is not an obvious participant in this process, but we'll have to ensure it's functioning as well. The Arcology project is mostly self-sustainable by design. We have to prepare vast hydroponic gardens on board the station to ensure that they can support its future population.
It's not about hope, Mr. Riggs. I'm both a scientist and a soldier, and I know that the odds for the sides of this coin are not even. I'm just trying to even them out.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_ghl_complete: This structure doesn't provide us with many advantages when it comes to building small-scale structures. However, the gravitational lensing antenna can be paired with the Orbital Scanner to aid us during exploration missions. It will increase the precision of our gravitational force readings, which will allow us to detect various points of interest within a given planetary location.

This is just the first step. It requires four additional Phased Graviton Ray Generators to be able to move an Arcology into orbit. We have to finish constructing all of its components to make it fully operational.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_ghl_generato: Acknowledged. Once this generator is online, we can start building the next one. They have to be constructed in sequential order.
Excellent. This generator will allow us to detect more points of interest when scouting new areas. Let's start preparing to build the next generator.
Copy that. With this unit online, we can start testing directional control over the lensing array.
This unit will allow us to detect even more points of interest during our exploration missions. We're making good progress. Two more and this Megastructure will be fully operational.
We'll need to double-check the changes that we made to all of the component connectors. We have to be super careful with this building.
Perfect. That gives us spatial control across three axes and increased situational awareness when scouting new missions. We're one step away from GHL's full operational capacity.

This is the last piece of the puzzle. Once it's online, we'll be able to move big objects into orbit without firing a single rocket booster. It will enable us to keep an arcology floating above ground while nanobot swarms assemble it. Lifting an object of that size would require tremendous effort using conventional means.

Oh, come on, Mr. Riggs. Our base is armed to the teeth, and I can easily jump back to HQ whenever you get destroyed. The attack wave that came at our base when we activated the Rift Station was the toughest challenge that we could ever expect. I'm safer here than I would be back at home.
Excellent! Finishing the Hyper Lens is a great achievement. We can finally cross it off our TODO list.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_ghl_start_01: Initiating deployment of the Gravitational Hyper Lens foundation. Once operational, it will allow us to move massive structures, such as zero-gravity construction workshops or arcologies into orbit without relying on conventional launch systems and spaceports. Unfortunately, it can't help us move smaller objects like our base buildings.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_ghl_start_02: We'll need to set up a network of Supercoolant Refineries to keep this machine running. It may be challenging to construct and maintain, but it's a key part of our plan.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_ghl_start_03: That is exactly how Stage Two and Stage Three of the standardized colonization process would play out. Military expeditions would pave their way from the Rift Station to the nearest resource-rich areas. They would destroy everything along their path and kill all of the native wildlife that could resemble any kind of threat. Airborne colonies can be easily relocated to more remote and safer locations. Thanks to our efforts, the researchers who arrive here will be able to identify safer areas before settling their arcologies on the ground.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_ghl_start_04: That is true, but we didn't try to avoid it, either. We jumped to a random place on the planet and clawed our way to survival. I know that conflict is inevitable, but we can minimize it.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_hydroponic_c: Good work. This facility will require substantial amounts of filtered Water and Biomass to maintain continuous food production, but while it is operational, it will significantly accelerate plant growth throughout the entire region. That should give us a major advantage in sustainable resource cultivation.
Additional Nutrient Flow Processing Stations will also increase the Nanopollinator Tower's efficiency and further accelerate plant growth.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_hydroponic_s: Excellent. At its core, this facility ensures long-term food security. It produces high-efficiency plant-based food for Arcology inhabitants using a closed-loop hydroponic system. The lab's second function is botanical analysis. It accelerates the growth of vegetation within its local area of operation through nanopollinators and constantly studies native Galatean flora to identify species with ideal properties for food production: fast growth, high nutrient density, and climate resilience. The best samples are selected for cultivation and future use.

It's a valid concern, Mr. Riggs. But everything the lab does is controlled and measured. The nanopollinators do not replace natural processes - they enhance them. All we're doing is accelerating growth cycles and helping native species reach their peak potential faster.

And we're studying every variable along the way. The lab continuously analyzes local flora, isolates the most nutrient-rich and adaptable species, and integrates them into sustainable food systems. It's evolution - just with guidance.
Exactly. It feeds the people living in the Arcologies and gives us long-term resilience. The better we understand this planet's biology, the better we can live with it.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_hydroponic_u: Good. That will further increase the efficiency of all of the Harvesting Stations that we have within this location.

Keeping the infrastructure buried reduces the Megastructure's footprint on the surface. Once this unit is online, we should see an increase in Nanopollinator Tower efficiency and faster growth of the local vegetation.
Excellent, that will speed up plant growth even further.

Galatean flora is unique in that it can extract most of the resources we need directly from the soil. We can learn to cultivate most of the local species by gathering their samples with the Bioscanner or by harvesting them.
Well, I'm glad you're so well educated.
Roger that, Mr. Riggs. The facility is now at 75% efficiency. We only need one more upgrade to be able to fully support an Arcology.
Good. We only need one more upgrade to finish this Megastructure.
Fantastic! This Megastructure is finally complete. That's another point off the list, Mr. Riggs. This facility will be enough to support an entire Arcology.
Well done, Mr. Riggs! This is the last upgrade for this Megastructure.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_mega_rift_ch: Roger that, Mr. Riggs. This is it. It's finally time to go.
No. I don't think so. This rift is opening very slowly. I'm not sure why you thought this would be any simpler than the first portal.
<sigh> Ok, then. Let's treat this as the final test of our base defenses.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_mega_rift_co: Roger that, Mr. Riggs. We'll need to provide it with a stable energy supply and all of the required liquid resources for the Antimatter Condensate Refinery. The pipe work around this thing is going to be a mess.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_mega_rift_ob: No. We are not going to wait on them. We are going back to Earth.

We build a new Rift Station. A full-scale one - the same kind that sent us here in the first place. It's massive and requires enormous amounts of resources, but it can send us to a single destination. No Quantum Entanglement Core needed.
Everything that we've done on this planet has never been done before. This is literally my job description, Mr. Riggs.

Ok, then. You must have the blueprints for a Prime Rift Station in your Common Nano-Fabrication blueprint template repository. We've increased our assembly capabilities so much that we should be able to construct it without dividing the process into separate components.
Come on, Riggs. We've got nothing better left to do anyway. Let's think where we can place this monster.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_mega_rift_re: I don't know what to say. We made it, Mr. Riggs. We can go home now.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_mega_rift_st: You've been here too long, Mr. Riggs. Your sense of humor is deteriorating.
Yes, and I'm also the one who's trying to get us back home. So why don't you stop complaining and tell me what we need to get all of this machinery moving once it's finished building?
Ok, ok. I know the procedure from that point. This is the last step. Let's get it done.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_nanobot_comp: Thanks to this pairing, we can benefit from remotely operating additional AI cores at other planetary locations without constructing local AI Hubs. However, this facility must remain fully operational at all times. Any disruptions will result in immediate loss of extended AI core capacity.
We'll need a lot more Titanium to finish this. Let's get to work.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_nanobot_star: Excellent. We need this center to fabricate Arcologies and other very large structures. The nanobot swarms will allow us to construct massive, self-sustaining habitats without reshaping the environment through traditional heavy industry. The Arcology Workshop specifically relies on precise nanobot operations to build structures that are suspended in the air.

The Nanobot Control Center can be a significant aid in setting up new base locations. Once it comes online, it will enable us to remotely operate a limited number of additional AI cores at any planetary location without the need to construct local AI Hubs.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_nanobot_upgr: Excellent. That's one more step toward full autonomy. More AI Cores at our disposal - wherever we need them.
This will increase our remote AI Core limit. With the Forge online, we can control more units across the planet without building local AI Hubs.
Perfect. With the added efficiency, we can now maintain additional remote AI Cores without overloading the system.
That'll boost processing speed and let us activate even more AI Cores remotely. Each upgrade gives us better reach without expanding our footprint.
That clears up bandwidth and gives us room to expand. More AI Cores online, and fewer materials wasted.
It'll reduce system strain by removing idle units and make room for even more remote AI Core allocation. We're building a scalable command structure - one node at a time.
That's it. This Megastructure is finally complete. You can cross it off the list, Mr. Riggs. The swarm is now large and fast enough to support the Arcology assembly process.

The nanobot swarm isn't just about numbers. To assemble an Arcology, we need a fabrication force large and stable enough to support massive construction elements. Without this forge, the swarm simply lacks the throughput to lift, position, and fuse megastructure-scale components. Once this upgrade is complete, we'll finally be able to handle the size and complexity of Arcology-scale assembly.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_complete: Perfect. Thanks to the increased working memory capacity, we can finally begin reformatting the Megastructure schematics. The Nanobot Swarm Control Center, the Gravitational Hyper Lens, and the Hydroponic Sustainability Lab blueprints are available for adaptation.
We can make the Quantum Cortex Laboratory even more efficient by upgrading it with all of its remaining components. That way, we could research the rest of the Megastructures much faster.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_start_01: Excellent, once it comes on-line we will be able to start repurposing additional schematics for larger Megastructures. We have to divide their blueprints into smaller parts that we can build piece by piece.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_start_02: Understood. I've already marked specific Megastructures for repurposing. Once we are ready, we can start reintegrating the plans for the Nanobot Swarm Production Center, the Gravitational Hyper Lens, and the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory. After these three Megastructures have been completed, we will be able to move to the most complex one, the Arcology Workshop.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_start_03: Riftbreaker-led colonization missions usually follow a standardized flow. Stage one - establishing a forward base of operations with a quantum entangled Rift Station connected back to Earth. Stage two - Earth's expeditionary forces reinforce the forward base with overwhelming force and rapidly build up the on-site economy by strip mining the surface of the planet and utilizing its resources without any limitations. Stage three - enormous industrial complexes devour the native landscape, permanently displacing or destroying the local ecosystem in the name of efficiency and control. Stage four - once the planet is fully subdued and restructured, civilian colonists are brought in to settle what's left, often unaware of what had to be erased to make room for them. I want to disrupt Stage 2 and Stage 3 of this process.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_start_04: That's how this process worked in the beginning, but things have changed, Mr. Riggs. Think about what happened to Solune 6, Vaelora 12, or even Ephorion 9b. Recent history shows that Stage Two and Stage Three serve as a pretext for rampant industrial exploitation. Collapsing the Rift bought us additional time that we can use to prepare the planet for technologically-led cohabitation. These Megastructures will allow us to claim that Galatea 37 is ready for Stage Four of the colonization process.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_start_05: In short, the Nanobot Swarm Production and Control Center will give us the ability to construct huge structures without introducing city-scale fabrication crawlers. The Gravitational Hyper Lens will allow us to move large objects like arcologies into orbit without building spaceports. The Hydroponic Sustainability Lab is going to allow us to research and produce food for the colonists in a sustainable manner. It should also increase the efficiency of our cultivators, so we can extract the necessary resources from the planet in a more friendly manner. The Arcology Workshop will allow us to construct self-contained temporary colonies for people arriving on Galatea 37. This will give them time to adapt to the local conditions in a safe environment.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_start_06: Arcologies will remain in orbit until the colonists can find optimal conditions for a ground-based settlement. Afterwards, they are supposed to land and slowly expand their habitats on the planet. This is an older, theoretical colonization concept that was first proposed by astrobiologists Vyremsky and Bomack in the late twenty-first century. I didn't invent all of this. There are a lot of smart people back on Earth who will know how to take care of this planet. I want to be able to pass the reins directly to them.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_start_07: Thank you, Mr. Riggs. Now let's get back to work.
dialog/story/endgame/ashley_qcl_upgrade_: Excellent. This upgrade noticeably improved our overall research speed. We can improve it even further by constructing additional QCL components.
The Coriolis Plasma Nullifier for the Quantum Cortex Laboratory will help us reduce the rotational drift in the plasma arrays. It will improve the lab's operational stability at higher frequencies.
Excellent. That should make long-term simulations far more reliable. We're one step closer to reaching QCL's full operational capacity.
I'm installing the Stabilized Hypercondensate Centrifuge for the QCL. The lab needs a stable condensate environment for high-fidelity data retention during extended processing cycles.
Excellent, we've almost finished upgrading the QCL. There's just one more upgrade left.
I'm starting the installation of the Supercharged Plasma Ion Accelerator for the QCL. To fully utilize the Quantum Cortex, we need to enhance its plasma processing efficiency.

Excellent. With the entire system running at peak efficiency, we can now process, adapt, and deploy Megastructure schematics without delay. This was a huge undertaking, no wonder these Megastructures are not meant to be built by Riftbreakers.

I'm initiating the construction of Kotiuk's Brown Matter Recyclers. The Quantum Cortex is already generating massive amounts of cooled plasma waste. We need a way to process that brown matter efficiently and recover the leftover energy.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_arcology_assem: Arcology assembly process complete. All systems are stable. Structural integrity verified. Gravitational anchors enabled. The first Arcology on Galatea 37 is parked in geostationary orbit.
Habitat systems are online. Life support, agriculture, and environmental controls are functioning within expected parameters. The Arcology is ready to receive its first civilian inhabitants.

The Arcology assembly process has been halted. Please verify that all of the required Megastructures are ready and able to function at the same time. The assembly process will resume automatically once they are back online.
Arcology assembly process interrupted. Please check if all of the required Megastructures are operational.
All Megastructures are reporting full operational status. Nano fabrication units online, orbital lift status - check. The Arcology Workshop is powering up. Assembly process commencing.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_arcology_end_0: Arcology Workshop construction finished. Ashley, please make sure that all of the remaining Megastructures are fully operational, and then approach the Workshop to initiate the assembly process.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_arcology_prep_: Status report: all critical Megastructures are ready for operation. The Quantum Cortex Laboratory, Gravitational Hyper Lens, Nanobot Swarm Control Center, and Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory have been fully integrated with all of the necessary components. We have reached the necessary threshold to start the construction of the Arcology Workshop.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_arcology_start: Initiating the Arcology Workshop construction process. This facility will serve as the primary assembly site for large-scale orbital and surface-based habitat systems.

This Megastructure consists of multiple specialized nano-fabrication workshops and an orbital elevator that is going to transport prefabricated components and nanobot assembly swarms to the optimal operating altitude. However, the elevator shaft does not provide sufficient support strength to maintain the assembly platform at the required height.

This type of zero-G construction work is typically carried out in specialized orbital stations that have all of the required infrastructure on-site. In our case, we'll be using large-scale, remote-controlled nanobot assembly swarms. They will be operating at a very large distance from our base. The Nanobot Swarm Control Center will have to remain online at all times, or the process will stop.
All of these things could be achieved in much simpler ways, Ashley. I hope that your faith in the people who come here is not going to be in vain.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_complete_0: Gravitational Hyper Lens construction complete. The primary lensing antenna is prepared for operation. Long-range mass manipulation protocols are ready for testing.
That is correct, Ashley. However, remember that this building has to be powered to provide this advantage. It requires a substantial amount of Super Coolant and Energy to function.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_generator1: Beginning construction of the first Phased Graviton Ray Generator. This unit will serve as the baseline anchor for the entire array. Their calibration must be very precise.
Phased Graviton Ray Generator One for the Gravitational Hyper Lens is operational. Output stability confirmed. Awaiting synchronization with additional units.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_generator2: Initiating deployment of the second Graviton Ray Generator. Phase differential calibration is in progress.
Phased Graviton Ray Generator Two for the Gravitational Hyper Lens is complete. Dual-beam modulation is synchronized. Directional modulation testing is commencing.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_generator3: Commencing construction of the third Phased Graviton Ray Generator. Beam synchronization systems are preparing for integration.
Phased Graviton Ray Generator Three for the Gravitational Hyper Lens is active. Triangular field stabilization is successful. Lensing antenna calibration is improving.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_generator4: Final Phased Graviton Ray Generator deployment initiated. Completion of this unit will enable full operational capacity.

Colonel Norstrom was right about that sacrifice part, Ashley. Most Riftbreakers would not risk prolonging their mission to set up all of this elaborate infrastructure. Your plan is sound. It will reduce the damage to the Galatean ecosystem, but you are putting your life on the line. These missions are supposed to be completed as quickly as possible to increase your chances of survival.
You are trivializing this matter, Ashley. Maybe that is what makes you qualified for the job.

Phased Graviton Ray Generator Four for the Gravitational Hyper Lens is fully operational. All of the Megastructure's components are complete. The Gravitational Hyper Lens is now ready to function at maximum capacity.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_start_01: This is a very specialized structure. It is composed of four symmetrical Phased Graviton Ray Generators and a central lensing antenna. It is difficult to maintain due to the intense heat that these components generate. Its operating temperatures are too high for typical cooling mechanisms.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_start_02: This is a marvelous machine, Ashley, but would it not be easier to build up settlements on the ground in the first place?
dialog/story/endgame/mech_ghl_start_03: We have not encountered a single location that would not contain hostile fauna.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_hydroponic_com: Construction of the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory is complete. All primary systems are stable and ready for activation.

Affirmative. However, please remember that if we intend to supply food for an entire Arcology and its first civilian inhabitants, we will need to finish constructing all of the Hydroponic Lab's components.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_hydroponic_sta: Initiating construction of the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory. The foundational blueprint includes the Nanopollinator Tower and a single Nutrient Flow Processing Station. We need to construct a total of eight processing stations to finish this megastructure.
Are you certain this level of artificial stimulation will not interfere too heavily with the local ecosystem?
You are effectively applying artificial selection pressure at an accelerated pace. That could have long-term implications on biodiversity.
So this facility serves both as a food production hub and as a botanical research center?
dialog/story/endgame/mech_hydroponic_upg: Second Nutrient Flow Processing Station for the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory is now operational. Resource flow and plant acceleration systems are responding normally.

Beginning installation of the second Nutrient Flow Processing Station for the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory. Ashley, please note that most of the structure will be located underground - nutrient conduits, thermal regulators, and circulation pumps.
Nutrient Flow Processing Stations Three and Four for the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory are fully integrated.
Deploying two additional Nutrient Flow Processing Stations for the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory.
Are you trying to teach me this unknown wisdom, or are you just talking to yourself, Ashley?
He that travels far knows much.
Stations Five and Six for the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory are operational.
Commencing installation of Nutrient Flow Processing Stations Five and Six. Deeper conduit systems are being extended to connect them to the central manifold under the facility.
Nutrient Flow Processing Stations Seven and Eight for the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory are fully operational. Full flow capacity achieved.
Final upgrade underway. Constructing the last two Nutrient Flow Processing Stations for the Hydroponic Sustainability Laboratory.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_mega_rift_char: Prime Rift Station has finished charging. The Quantum Synchronization Core is ready.
Prime Rift Station activated. The portal is opening up. It should not take long.
That might have been a small miscalculation. Ashley, I think we have a bigger problem. I am detecting a lot of movement heading towards the Rift Station.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_mega_rift_comp: Prime Rift Station construction is complete. Structural integrity confirmed. The Quantum Coil Accelerator and the Antimatter Condensate Refinery are awaiting resource input.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_mega_rift_obje: Ashley, we have finished building all of the Megastructures, and the arcology assembly process has been started. We have crossed everything off the list. Do you have any additional goals for us, or do you want to wait until Riftbreaker Command sends in another Riftbreaker with a new Quantum Synchronization Core?
What? How do you intend to accomplish that? The original Rift Station's Quantum Entanglement Core was destroyed when the portal collapsed. We no longer have a functioning connection back to Earth.
That is ludicrous, Ashley. It has never been done before. Not by a single Riftbreaker.
Well, that is correct, Ashley. I can not deny that.

Affirmative, Ashley. We can start working on a Prime Rift Station, but I am not certain if we can get it done. Construction requirements are one thing, and the resources required to power it up are another.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_mega_rift_read: Rift Station Prime is ready for activation. All of the required resources have been delivered. Energy levels are stable, and system diagnostics report full operational readiness. You can walk up to it to start the rift jump procedure.
That is true, Ashley. All you have to do now is activate the portal.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_mega_rift_star: Initiating construction of the Prime Rift Station. This facility exceeds the scale of all previously built Megastructures. It is a magnificent monument to your stubbornness and your will to prove me wrong. Even if we will never be able to power it up because of its insane resource requirements.
Am I starting to sound too much like a human? You made me stay here, remember?

This structure is conversely simpler than the Rift Station that we have built before. It is comprised of three major components: the Rift Gate Arch, the Quantum Coil Accelerator, and the Antimatter Condensate Refinery.

The Quantum Coil Accelerator requires a lot of energy, and the Antimatter Condensate Refinery requires a lot of liquids that are hard to come by. We can open up the Rift as soon as we have gathered all of that.

This machine is so powerful that it can be activated much faster than its smaller counter part. Once it is activated, it creates a Quantum Synchronization Core that is entangled with the station and enters stand-by mode after the first rift jump. Another, smaller Rift Station has to be built on the other side to create a stable two-way connection between the portals.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_nanobot_comple: The construction of the foundation for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center is complete. Operational Control Array Antenna is synchronized with the Planetary Scanner and ready for distributed assembly operations.

May I remind you, Ashley, that this is only the first step. To enable full-scale Arcology construction, we must complete four additional Nanobot Swarm Control Center components. I recommend prioritizing their research and deployment as soon as possible.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_nanobot_start_: Initiating construction of the Nanobot Swarm Control Center. This facility will allow us to coordinate autonomous nanobot activity across large construction sites.

Once active, the Nanobot Control Center draws a significant amount of energy and requires a substantial number of AI cores to maintain coordination. We will need a stable energy grid and dedicated infrastructure to support it.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_nanobot_upgrad: First Nanite Forge for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center is fully operational. Nanobot output has increased significantly. Synchronization with control systems confirmed.
Beginning construction of the First Nanite Forge. This component will enhance production throughput for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center.
Resource Atomization Accelerator for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center is online. Raw material processing speed has increased, which will allow us to support larger nanobot swarms.
Initiating installation of the Resource Atomization Accelerator. This component will improve resource intake efficiency for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center.
Nanobot Recycler for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center is fully operational. Internal resource loss has been reduced, and reclamation systems are stable.
Beginning construction of the Nanobot Recycler. This upgrade will improve material efficiency within the Nanobot Swarm Control Center by reclaiming and reprocessing nullified bots.
Second Nanite Forge for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center is operational. Nanobot production has reached peak capacity.
Final upgrade underway. Constructing the Second Nanite Forge for the Nanobot Swarm Control Center.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_complete_0: Quantum Cortex Laboratory construction finished. Primary structure integrity confirmed. The central processing databank is functioning at optimal parameters.

We could theoretically reprocess these schematics without powering up the Quantum Cortex. However, this building alone is more powerful than the entirety of our existing research infrastructure combined. I advise that we deliver the required supercharged plasma and energy inputs to bring the facility to full operational capacity.

That is a good point, Ashley. Please check the resource requirements for each Megastructure. They use up different types of resources. It might be efficient to construct them out of order as the required resources gradually become available.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_start_01: Foundation deployment for the Quantum Cortex Laboratory is in progress.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_start_02: Ashley, remember that this is only the foundation and the central processing databank for this structure. This facility will allow us to store and process enormous datasets even when it is not sufficiently powered. However, if we want to take advantage of its processing capabilities we will have to deliver huge amounts of supercharged plasma and energy to keep the Quantum Cortex operational. Furthermore, if we want to unlock the full potential of this facility, we will have to research construction schematics for its remaining modules that are suitable for fabrication through my assembly systems.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_start_03: How do you intend to use these technologies, Ashley?
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_start_04: Stage 2 and Stage 3 are required to create safe living conditions for future colonists. The colonization protocol indicates that their impact on the local ecosystem should be minimal.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_start_05: I am sorry, Ashley, but I still do not understand the specific purpose you have in mind for these buildings.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_start_06: An arcology is a semi self-suffcient city. If we construct it directly in the orbit above the planet, then it will be safe from the local fauna. The infrastructure that we will have built on the ground will be enough to support it. I think I understand that part, but why would people want to live in a city up in space if the goal was to colonize the planet?
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_start_07: Ok, this is starting to make more sense. I will save the rest of my questions for later.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_upgrade_01: The Quantum Cortex Laboratory Coriolis Plasma Nullifier has been installed. Plasma flow has stabilized. Lateral fluctuation has dropped to negligible levels.
Affirmative. Nullifier assembly in progress. This component will suppress lateral distortions in supercharged plasma flow, thereby improving overall processing speed.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_upgrade_02: Quantum Cortex Laboratory upgrade complete. Stabilized Hypercondensate Centrifuge online. Core systems now exhibit a 63% increase in data integrity under high-load processing conditions.
Initiating centrifuge assembly. Once stabilized, this module will reduce quantum decoherence and improve neural lattice computational consistency during prolonged operations.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_upgrade_03: Quantum Cortex Laboratory upgrade finished. Supercharged Plasma Ion Accelerator installation complete. Quantum Cortex plasma processing efficiency has increased by 67,4%. Processing capacity has been recalibrated accordingly.
Understood. This module will significantly improve energy delivery efficiency across all neural computation channels. Plasma regulation protocols are now engaged.
dialog/story/endgame/mech_qcl_upgrade_04: Quantum Cortex Laboratory upgrade complete. Kotiuk's Brown Matter Recyclers are fully operational. Brown matter flow is stabilized. Energy reclamation systems are operating at maximum efficiency. All core subsystems report full synchronization. The Quantum Cortex Laboratory has reached 100% operational capacity.
Your behavioral pattern does not fit the typical Riftbreaker stereotype, Ashley.

Acknowledged. Initializing container deployment. These systems will isolate and neutralize plasma residue, accelerate waste handling, and recycle the residual thermal energy back into the Quantum Cortex's power loop.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_alien_l: Orbital Scanner construction is in progress, but before we start jumping off to different parts of the planet, we should build the necessary local research facilities. The Communications Hub can only help us with downloading already developed technologies back from Earth. Still, one of the main reasons why we came here is to conduct research and to learn about the environment that we encounter here.

Ok, we've got all of the necessary technologies downloaded. This building requires a supply of clean water to operate. It would be best to place it close to a pool of mud or sludge that we can filter.

Finally! The Alien Research Lab is operational. We can start gathering research samples and scanning the local flora and fauna. We can also craft the Bioscanner in the Armory to begin collecting samples without harming the environment. We don't have to kill the creatures that aren't hostile to us to advance our research. This is so exciting. We can finally start working on the thing that we came here to do.
That's true, but we also have to study this planet to ensure that it is safe for colonization and to minimize the damage done to the local ecosystem by future colonists.
I'm the only human on this planet. I can set my own list of priorities.

Finally! The Alien Research Lab is operational. We can start gathering research samples and scanning the local flora and fauna. We can use the Bioscanner to begin collecting samples without destroying the environment. It's the safest and most efficient way to advance our research. This is so exciting. We can finally start working on the thing that we came here to do.
Fantastic. I can't wait for it to be built. This building is going to open up a whole new range of possibilities for us. If I had a base like that on Orion, I wouldn't have lost my arm back then.

I got careless while searching for Anoryx crystals. I found a fascinating growth anomaly that was transforming all of its surroundings. I've never seen anything like that, so I had to take a sample. I was shielded inside a Recon Suit, but when I grabbed the crystal with my hand, it just went through it. My entire arm was infected.
They only work in conjunction with a lab like this. I didn't have a base on Orion or a Mecha-suit to build one.
Ok, let's not get too emotional about that. If you look at it from a different perspective, I got an enhanced bio-mechanical arm replacement, and I still got the sample.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_build_h: Headquarters construction is in progress. This is going to be our main base of operations on Galatea 37. Our new home.
That's basic training, Mr. Riggs. Let's focus on the less obvious things.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_cobalt_: Many of the more advanced buildings require a lot of Cobalt to be built or upgraded. There's not enough of this resource in this area to cover our needs. Mr. Riggs, can you calibrate the Planetary Scanner to search for more Cobalt?
Excellent, it's even located within the tropical zone, so it should be more hospitable than the other areas of the planet that we've visited. Let's go there as soon as possible.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_comm_hu: It's a pity that we can't upload anything back to Earth. There's so much data to be gathered here. I can't wait to start collecting research specimens.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_ending_: I want to build a new home for humanity on this planet, and I don't want it to be strip-mined, exploited, and destroyed before there's even a chance to create a self-sustainable civilian colony.

You've seen that final attack wave. All of these species from different parts of the planet were working together against us. If the expeditionary forces had stepped through that portal, they'd quickly label this planet as a hostile environment not suitable for human colonization. The local fauna is too aggressive and too dangerous to risk cohabitation.

I don't know. But my duty as a scientist is to try to find out how to do that. There's too much at stake not to try that. Destroying the portal only bought us some time. They will reconstruct the Rift Synchronisation Core, and they will prepare a new candidate for this mission. We can't stop humanity from claiming Galatea, but we have to try to prepare it for peaceful colonization.
Thank you, Mr. Riggs. Note taken.

I'm glad to have you on board, Mr. Riggs. Let's start with making our presence more friendly to the environment. I think that the first step to creating a self-sustaining economy is to switch from mining resources to cultivating them.
That's not all. If we want to learn how to live near these creatures, we have to study them. We need to gather research samples for all the species that we've met here.
The longest one, Mr. Riggs. The longest one.

I've been thinking about the possibility of extending our mission on Galatea for quite some time, but I was hesitant about whether we could pull this off. I'm certain that staying here is the right choice that will bring the most benefit to both Humanity and Galatea, and at the same time, I know that this is the longer, much harder path.

Yes, but we will have to go beyond the tasks that were originally planned for our mission and make use of technology that wasn't originally designed for this Mecha-suit. I need you to access the Common Nano-Fabrication blueprint template repository and decompress specific Megastructure schematics.
That's true, but we can modify the schematics and build them piece by piece.

That was part of my plan, Mr. Riggs. Allowing the Rift Station portal to collapse may look like a last-minute decision, but it was growing inside me for a very long time. Anyway, let's try to build this thing first. I'll explain the rest when we get there.

This Megastructure is in a totally different league. The energy and supercharged plasma requirements are much higher than anything we've ever built. Maybe we should search for a new base location to build this monstrosity. The Rift Station was child's play in comparison.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_orbital: We don't have the required schematics to build an Orbital Scanner. We have to download the Orbital Scanning technology through the Communications Hub.
Alright, It looks like we're missing another piece of technology. This element is not easy to find, so we'll need to download the Cobalt Handling technology and search for it with a Geoscanner.
It's not that close, really. We should craft some better equipment before we try to venture out that far.
It looks like it's going to be very useful. We could at least scan the area around our base with it. Who knows what's hiding under our feet.
Then we should definitely check the area around our base with it...
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_return_: It's good to be back at the HQ. I feel much safer here.
Ok, Mr. Riggs. Let's check if our base is intact after our absence, and then we can go back to exploring the other biomes.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_rift_ju: Welcome to Galatea 37, Mr. Riggs. It's so beautiful here. Virtual simulations on Earth were good, but this is amazing. An alien tropical paradise... and we're the first humans to experience it.
You could at least pretend to be human, just a bit. But you're right. There's no going home until we can construct a functioning Rift Station. Let's start with the basics.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_rift_st: That's true. It's a massive building with multiple components and pipeline connections for plasma fuel and coolant. It's going to be the central structure in our base, with multiple support buildings, so we should plan a lot of free space around it. Let's start by placing the foundation.

The Rift Station has three main components that require a lot of rare resources to be built: the Fusion Field Accelerator requires enriched Uranium, the Hyper Particle Condenser requires Palladium, and the Quantum Gate Stabilizer, which requires Titanium. We haven't found any traces of these elements near our base.
This is going to take some time. Let's focus on other tasks.
Excellent, we're one step closer to getting the Rift Station operational.
Ok, we're going to have to wait some time for the construction to finish. This is a very complex piece of machinery.
Finally! It's a big milestone towards setting up a stable connection back to Earth.
We can't rush this building. I wouldn't want to get scrambled walking through an unstable rift portal...
No, I guess no one would want that.
Yes, it was supposed to. I guess they didn't program that for you...
That's great news, it wasn't easy to gather all that Titanium to build it.
You sometimes sound a bit like colonel Norstrom, do you know that?
Oh, please do, Mr. Riggs. This is exactly what I wanted to hear after traveling halfway through the galaxy.
Ok, that's a nice speech. It sounds very uplifting. However, I guess they didn't read my bio well enough.
The sacrifice part.
Yes. That, and a few other things...
That's enough of colonel Norstrom. Let's skip the military pathos and stick to your original programming. We've got a planet to explore.
Oh no! The portal has collapsed. The entire procedure is aborted.
We made it. It's hard to believe that this moment is finally here.
There's so much diverse life on this planet. We've been here for so long, but have we studied the ecosystem enough to start colonizing the planet?
I have to admit that I sometimes thought we wouldn't be going home. Yet, this is it. Our adventure on this planet is finished. We can go back through the portal.
No, Mr. Riggs. We aren't ready for that. We aren't ready to allow our civilization onto this planet.
No, we don't have to go back through the portal. I think there's a different way.

Ok, Mr. Riggs. We're going to need three primary ingredients to power up the portal: a starting charge that's going to initiate the sequence, a stable flow of supercharged plasma for the rift gate, and coolant to stabilize the station during the process. This shouldn't be that difficult with the infrastructure we already have in place.

Oh no. <sigh> We should have expected this. This planet's magnetic field is not behaving in a normal way. We won't be able to get off the planet if we don't stabilize the magnetic field around the Rift Station.

Yes, we can do that, but this complicates the process significantly. Magnetic Stabilizers require a lot of resources to be built, they use a lot of energy themselves, they require cooling, and we will have to place them around the portal, but not too close to each other.

We might also have to rearrange the buildings around the Rift Station to make all of this possible. Well, as someone once said, we're not doing this because it is easy, but because it is hard. Let's get to work then...
That's great. We can move forward with the rest of the preparations.
It wasn't easy, but we're there. It's hard to believe that we are finally approaching the moment of powering up the rift.

We should build up additional reserves of supercharged plasma and coolant in liquid storages. If the Rift Station power-up sequence is interrupted, then we will have to cool off the station and restart the entire process.
This is going to be our final battle on Galatea 37. Let's make sure that we are ready before we push the button.
The power-up sequence is creating seismic waves. I can feel the ground shaking. The weather is going crazy. It looks like the whole planet is going mad.

My hand is trembling. I'm not sure if I'm stressing more about the battle or about opening the connection to Earth. We've been here for so long... every day fighting for survival. We are prepared for the battle. I know we are.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_upgrade: We can't save this world if we let it kill us, ey Mr. Grumpy?
Haha, I hope you're not offended, are you?
Come on, Riggs, let's not be so serious. I had to give you a better name than what they called you.
dialog/story/headquarters/ashley_warmup_: Standard protocol advises to set up walls and sentinel towers around the base. However, I don't expect as much aggression from the native fauna as in the simulations.
The environment in the simulation was very accurate, that's true, but the scenario was crafted by Riftbreaker Command. They usually focus on the brute force aspect of these missions.
You never give up, do you?
Ok, Mr. Stubborn. I guess it won't hurt to set up some solid defenses. Just in-case.
Ok, these sentinel towers should keep us safe, so we can focus on expanding our base further.
I guess you were right about setting up more defenses. We'll have to handle this ourselves. Remember to use repair kits if necessary.

I am skeptical about the designated procedure of preparing this planet for colonization. Humanity lost its love for nature after the Yellowstone eruption, but that doesn't mean we shouldn't try to preserve this ecosystem.
That's not entirely true. Other riftbreaking missions have already secured a number of resource-rich planets for humanity. We're not on the brink of extinction.

I know what has to be done. That's not the point. Galatea has to be prepared for colonization. I don't doubt that. If I didn't come here myself, then someone else would have. I believe that we can do this in a better way. We have to defend ourselves, and we have to secure the necessary resources to set up the Rift Station, but we don't have to destroy all the wildlife we encounter. Humanity doesn't need another stripped-down factory world. If we want to progress as a species, then we should study this planet to learn how to blend with the environment and prepare a safe home for humanity.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_alien_lab: We can research new technologies based on samples of alien life forms or any new substances that we encounter if we construct the Alien Research Laboratory building.
The Alien Research Laboratory is a complex structure and requires multiple schematics in order to be built. Download the necessary technologies using the Communications Hub.

Alien Research Laboratory construction finished, we have to supply it with clean water to keep it operational. You can produce clean water by placing a pump in any type of liquid and delivering it to a Water Filtering Plant for processing. Connect the output from the Water Filtering Plant to the Alien Research Laboratory using pipes.
Ashley, don't forget that our primary objective is to establish a two-way portal back to Earth to enable human colonization of Galatea 37.
Minimizing damage to the local ecosystem is listed at the end of the official list of priorities of this mission.
Alien Research Laboratory construction in progress.
Why didn't you use a Bioscanner to take the sample?
I am sorry to hear that, Ashley, and I am glad that we got paired together. I will not allow something like that to happen to you.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_build_hq_: We have to protect this building at all costs. You will be teleported here whenever I am critically damaged. There is no other backup if this building is destroyed.
I am required to remind you of basic protocol, even if we've done this before.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_cobalt_mi: Affirmative Ashley, I'm starting the scanning procedure right now.
Orbital Scanning completed. We have found a new planetary location that is rich in cobalt deposits and would be perfect for establishing a new Cobalt mining outpost.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_comm_hub_: Communications Hub construction in progress. We can download all the technology blueprints that we need through this building's quantum entanglement template matrix.
We will be able to share all of our research data as soon as the Rift Station is operational and the Rift back to Earth has been opened. Let's focus on that first.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_ending_st: The Rift Synchronization Core is destroyed. We can't reconstruct it ourselves. We have failed our primary objective.
Why would you do that? That does not make any sense.
We were not tasked with building up a self-sustainable colony. Why do you assume that the planet would be destroyed? That was not the plan for Galatea 37.
That is a bold assumption, and even if that were to be true, destroying the portal still does not make any sense. How do you imagine to make these creatures not try to destroy us?
Ashley, your goals are my goals, and I will always follow your commands. However, please note that I think you are insane.
Ok, Ms. Crazy Scientist, how do you want to save this world?
It might be possible, but we are going to have to gather saplings from a lot of flora. Constructing such an amount of cultivators is going to be a huge undertaking.
Roger that, Ashley. This is going to be a long mission.
What is done is done, Ashley. You have made your decision. Do you have a plan beyond this point?

I can access those blueprints, but I can not use them. They were designed for much bigger, city-scale fabrication crawlers. The resource output requirements for building Megastructures exceed the operational thresholds of my assembly systems.

That is possible, but very time-consuming. We would have to increase our computing power to prepare these megastructures in a reasonable time frame. I could construct a semi-functioning foundation for a Quantum Cortex Laboratory. It is the only Megastructure that I can start working on without additional modifications.

I have added the Quantum Cortex Laboratory foundation to the list of available schematics. Please check its construction and maintenance requirements, and then carefully pick the location where you want to build it. Remember that it does not have to be built at our HQ. Some biomes may be better suited to housing this project.
Well, you have what you asked for, Ashley.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_orbital_s: The Orbital Scanner uses advanced technology and requires additional resources in order to be built. We need to gather a large amount of Cobalt to construct this building.
Ashley, my sensors are picking up an underground Cobalt deposit nearby. I've marked its approximate location on your map. We should go there and search for it with the Geoscanner.
Ashley, now that you've got practice with using the Geoscanner, you can use it to search for hidden resource deposits, geothermal vents, or any other underground anomalies.
It is also capable of finding hidden underground alien life forms...

We now have enough Cobalt to construct the Orbital Scanner. Also, be mindful of this building's energy consumption. We should probably build some additional power plants and improve our energy storage capacity before connecting it to the power grid.
Orbital Scanner construction finished. Planetary geomapping procedure in progress. Searching for traces of Uranium, Palladium, and Titanium. This process may take some time.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_return_fr: Ashley, remember that we can travel between planetary locations using the Orbital Scanner interface whenever you are ready. You can also check our list of objectives on that screen.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_rift_jump: Rift jump successful. All systems check. Gravitational strength 1.05G. Atmospheric pressure within safe levels. Magnetic field check... error. Repeat magnetic field check with stationary equipment. Star system positioning check... Milky Way Galaxy, Sycorax Belt, planet Galatea 37. Ashley, we have arrived.
I'm not exactly human... You have a few parts missing as well, and the paradise part is also left to be determined. Remember your training Ashley. We should set up a base as soon as possible.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_rift_stat: Ashley, now that the basic base setup is complete, we should start working on our primary objective – constructing an interplanetary Rift Station. It is going to take a long time to build, so we should start working on it as soon as possible.
The construction of the Rift Station foundation has been completed. We need to construct all of the Rift Station components before we can start powering up the portal.

These resources might not be present anywhere near our location. We should construct an Orbital Scanner to start scouting for interesting locations around the entire planet. It will allow us to establish precise coordinates for long-range Rift Jumps around the planet.
Fusion Field Accelerator construction in progress.
Fusion Field Accelerator construction finished.
Hyper Particle Condenser construction in progress.
Hyper Particle Condenser construction finished.
Quantum Gate Stabilizer construction in progress.
Would anyone want that?
Was that a joke?
I guess they didn't program that for you either, ha ha.
Quantum Gate Stabilizer construction finished.
Construction of the Rift Station's foundation is in progress. Congratulations Ashley, this milestone marks the beginning of the next chapter of our mission on this planet.

I received additional instructions on how to motivate you and keep your spirit high during this mission. They were indeed written by colonel Norstrom and revised by admiral von Blofeld. Would you like me to read what I was instructed to tell you for this occasion?

Captain Nowak, you were selected for the Rift Jump to Galatea 37 as an exceptional individual. You are amongst the elite of the elite of Earth's Expeditionary Forces. During your service with the Extraterrestrial Science Corps, you have time and again shown courage, bravery, and an unflinching willingness to sacrifice yourself to complete your objectives. You are dest...
What do you mean?
Do you mean the Orion mission? You were working without me back then.
Do you want me to read further motivational pieces?
Roger that, Ashley, I am archiving all of the motivational speeches.
Warning! Rift Station charge-up sequence interrupted.
The Rift Station needs to cool off after the failure. We have to fix whatever caused the sequence to abort, wait until it is ready to start charging up again, and then restart the entire procedure.
The Rift Station has finished cooling off after the failure and is ready to charge up again.
The flow of Coolant to the Rift Station has been interrupted. Ashley, we have to check our Coolant supply.
The flow of Supercharged Plasma to the Rift Station has been interrupted. Ashley, we have to check our Supercharged Plasma supply.
Rift Station power failure detected. Ashley, the station lost power and stopped working.
Magnetic field stabilization failure. Ashley, our Magnetic Stabilizers stopped working.
Rift Station, power-up sequence completed. The quantum gate is stabilized. Ashley, we are ready to open the two-way portal back to Earth.

We are receiving signals from the Earth. Quantum entanglement with the station back on Earth is confirmed. You have to manually insert your personal rift synchronization core to confirm the procedure from our side before the rift portal can be opened.

Ashley, your primary objective was to establish a two-way portal back to Earth. Studying the ecosystem is not a priority. Your quantum synchronization core is paired with an identical object back on Earth. This pairing is fragile. If we don't finalize the connection now, the quantum entanglement is going to collapse and destroy the rift synchronization cores. If we don't go now, there is no guarantee that we'll ever be able to return to Earth...
Riftbreaker quantum synchronization core successfully finished pairing with the home station. The rift from Galatea 37 to Earth is breaking open.
Ashley, you have to finish the procedure, or the portal will collapse. We won't be able to get back to Earth if you don't act now!

The rift power-up procedure has overloaded the quantum synchronization core. Ashley, the portal is shutting down. We will not be able to open the rift to Earth without that core. Why didn’t you finish the procedure?

Ashley, we have assembled all of the Rift Station components. We can start preparing the station for the power-up sequence. I am initiating a full diagnostics check on all of the station's subsystems.

Station diagnostics complete. Portal gate structure check – ok. Power couplings check – ok. Fusion Field Accelerator plasma conduits check – ok. Hyper Particle Condenser capacitor flux – ok. Quantum Gate Stabilizer magnetron check – error, magnetic field unstable.
We can stabilize the magnetic field by constructing additional Magnetic Field Stabilizers around the Rift Station.
We can expand our external mining outposts to speed up the process of gathering resources. We can also use the Orbital Scanner to search for new resource-rich locations.
Magnetic stabilizers are in place and operational. I am re-running diagnostics on the Quantum Gate Stabilizer. All systems check, magnetic field stabilized, quantum magnetron operational.

Ashley, we have assembled all of the Rift Station components. We can start preparing the station for the power-up sequence. Walk onto the Rift Station to initiate a complete diagnostics check of all of the station's subsystems.
I am initiating Rift Station diagnostics. Ashley, in the meantime, please verify the list of resources that are necessary to begin the Rift Station charge-up procedure.
Ashley, we have finished all of the necessary preparations for the Rift Station power-up sequence.

Please keep in mind that once we start the power-up sequence, it is going to need some time to finish. We will have to maintain a stable flow of all of the required resources during that time. The starting charge is only enough to initiate the Rift Station power-up sequence. The energy consumption of the station is going to be extremely high during the entire process. Please make sure that our energy grid can handle that strain before starting the procedure.
