The Rift Station is going to emit an enormous amount of high-frequency energy waves. We've already aggravated the local fauna with our actions. These emissions will be going out in a very large radius, so they will alarm all of the potentially aggressive creatures within kilometers of our base. We have to prepare for the strongest attack that we've ever seen. We have to make sure that our base is secured from all directions.
Rift Station power-up sequence initiated. The energy flux is creating intense electromagnetic waves. I am detecting minor gravitational field disturbances.
I am detecting hordes of creatures moving towards our base from all directions. There are thousands of them. Ashley, this is it.
Rift Station power-up sequence is 25% ready.
Rift Station power-up sequence is 50% ready.
Rift Station power-up sequence is 75% ready.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_upgrade_h: I am glad that we are back on the same page about properly securing our base.
Why do you insist on calling me names?
Rift Jump and Exploration Mecha-Suit, Mark IV - Griffin variant. What is wrong with that name?
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_01: So far, it looks like the long-range quantum scans were very accurate. The local fauna and flora appear almost exactly like during training. Follow the protocol, Ashley.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_02: Do you want to run a brute force check if this is a simulation?
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_05: I am detecting a large group of creatures heading our way.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_06: Base defenses should be strong enough to hold them back.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_07: Ashley, we don't have a lot of defensive structures. Prepare to fight.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_08: Ashley, are you still skeptical about the local creatures' level of aggression?
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_09: Earth is barely habitable at this point. We have to secure Galatea 37 for colonization and resource extraction as soon as possible. Excessive care about the local environment is unnecessary.
dialog/story/headquarters/mech_warmup_10: Our goals on this mission are clear, and our survival and security is the top priority. Damage to the ecosystem is inevitable. You wanted to come here yourself, and you knew what has to be done. Are you doubting the mission?
dialog/story/ice/ashley_first_mission_la: Understood. The local fauna may prove to be more dangerous than we could otherwise expect it to be. Lets see what else this biome has to offer.
dialog/story/ice/mech_first_mission_land: Rift jump successful. Extreme weather conditions detected. Outside temperatures in this area can dip below the 170 Kelvin threshold. Be careful, Ashley. Such low temperatures may result in decreased structural integrity of our buildings.
dialog/story/jungle/ashley_find_rare_res: A lot of the flora that grows here contains Hazenite. Many Galatean plants have adapted to crystallize various minerals directly from the soil. Some fauna species to feed directly on these minerals. It's a fascinating ecosystem.

My initial scans of these large bulbous life forms, that look a bit like fossilized trees with crystals, indicate that their closest categorization should be fungi. Their specific subspecies that cultivates orange crystals and grows orange leaves appears to be feeding of Hazenite in the soil. We could learn a lot by gathering more samples of this life form.

We've gathered enough samples to start researching Hazenite Handling in the Alien Research Lab. This technology will enable crafting of a lot of new equipment, and gathering Hazenite from a broad range of fauna and flora.

Hmm, there's a lot of these bulbous mushrooms growing here. They are feeding off of the Hazenite from the soil and crystalizing it in a form that can be harvested. If we could accelerate their growth then we could extract the Hazenite using these natural organisms.

Excellent. I have a feeling that we should strengthen our defenses while we're waiting for the growth cycle to complete. Whenever we try to exploit any of the natural resources on this planet we get attacked by hordes of aggressive creatures.
dialog/story/jungle/ashley_resource_outp: Great, that is just what we were looking for. We can set up a large mining base in this location to support our headquarters and rift station construction.
Understood, Mr. Riggs. Let's make sure to set up solid defenses for this outpost.
Cobalt mining is moving forward. This location is very rich in resources. We can also set up additional Carbonium and Ironium factories.
dialog/story/jungle/mech_find_rare_resou: Rift jump successful.  This area is very rich in Hazenite. My scans have indicated an especially large deposit near our position. I recommend we go there first.
I recommend using the Bioscanner to scan them. This way, we can gather research samples much quicker.
Ashley, there is a lot of Hazenite in this area, but it is not concentrated enough for my equipment to extract it. We have to search for it elsewhere.
We could construct a Cultivator in this area to accelerate the growth of these mushrooms. We will need to supply it with filtered water to make it operational.
The Cultivator is operational. It will require some time to bring these mushrooms to the size when we can harvest them in an efficient manner.
We've gathered enough Hazenite to start crafting new equipment. Ashley, we can stay here and harvest more minerals or we can return to our primary objectives.

Ashley, we should gather more research specimens of this species in order for my AI subroutines to familiarize themselves with it. This will allow me to harvest Hazenite directly from these life forms.

We have achieved a high enough Familiarity level of this species that we can now cultivate its saplings by constructing the Cultivator building. We can continue gathering research samples to improve our knowledge about this or any other species.
We can automate the process of gathering resources by constructing a Harvester building close to the Cultivator.

The enemies in this area can hide from our sensors. They are not as numerous as in the other parts of this biome, but they can be even more dangerous. Be weary, Ashley. I will not be able to warn you of incoming attacks.
dialog/story/jungle/mech_resource_outpos: Rift jump successful. Initial scans indicate rich Cobalt veins in the area as well as multiple Ironium and Carbonium deposits.
Ashley, I am picking up a lot more activity in this area. We should expect strong resistance from the local creatures.
Remember that we don't have to build everything at once. We can freely rift jump between outposts and return here later if we need to expand our mining operations.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_find_new_resou: Mr. Riggs, can you track the incoming rocks that can pose a threat to your armor?
Ok, this mission is going to be intense. We'll have to dodge volcanic bombardment and search for Titanium at the same time.
That makes perfect sense. Equip the Geoscanner, and let's start hunting for treasure!
Excellent. Let's queue up downloading of the appropriate Titanium Handling technology and start scanning for a good location for a Titanium mining outpost.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_find_rare_reso: Ok, let's grab the Geoscanner and start searching for Ferdonite. I'm sure we can create some special equipment with it.
We've gathered enough crystal samples to start researching Ferdonite handling. This is going to unlock a lot of exotic technologies.

Excellent, we should gather as much Ferdonite as possible. It will allow us to build new equipment that we can use to manipulate gravitational waves. I have heard of such inventions, but I've never seen them myself before.
Oh, that makes things more complicated...
We've gathered a sizeable amount of Ferdonite. This should be enough to start crafting new equipment. We can stay here and try to find even more, or get back to our primary objectives.
We can use the Bioscanner to gather research specimens more efficiently. It's the perfect tool for this task.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_find_samples_0: Wow, the parameters in this area are crazy. It's like a completely different planet. The gravity in this place is acting weird. Something must be causing this.
You're right, we can investigate what's causing these anomalies as we move forward. We can place the Radars in the safe zones created by the cryo-plants.
Building CryoStations won't make much sense until we can find a much larger Titanium deposit. Let's not waste Titanium unless it's necessary.
Ok, we've built the first radar station. It isn't easy to provide enough power in this biome. The atmosphere is very thick, and it's reducing the effectiveness of wind and solar generators.
Excellent, let's go there and search for it with the Geoscanner.
We've got it. But the amount of Titanium in this deposit is not impressive, to say the least.
Ok, let's start the Orbital Scanning procedure. We have to find more Titanium.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_resource_outpo: Excellent, we've hit the jackpot. Let's look for an easy to defend location near one of the Titanium deposits to establish an Outpost.
We could also start building up next to a patch of cryo plants. However, that can be dangerous as these plants may get destroyed during an attack.

We're practically surrounded by vast amounts of energy that is stored in the magma all around us. It would be possible to utilize magma as a liquid to produce power if we'd invest in appropriate technology.
You're right. Let's secure our base and speed up the mining process as soon as possible.

The attacks against our outpost are increasing in strength and numbers. We should build up more advanced defensive towers to protect our base. This area is very rich in resources, so we can establish additional mining bases if we need to expand our economy.

The mining operation must have disturbed a lot of them. We are going to need advanced defense towers to repel these creatures. Also, let's not forget about setting up minefields on the critical paths towards our outpost.
Nothing is easy in this place. Intense heat, volcanic rock bombardment, walking stone giants, and swarms of fire-breathing snakes. Can it get any harder than this?

This outpost will remain as a permanent base of operations. We can even build up more mines and factories here to boost our economy. All of the resources that are produced here will be automatically transferred to our HQ as long as the Orbital Scanner is operational. Long-distance rift travel and transportation are not possible without it.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_scout_01: We've landed in the middle of an active volcanic area. We expected high temperatures, but not this high. The measurements from the Orbital Scanner were different. Something's off. We won't survive here for long.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_scout_02: We received some anomalous readings from the Orbital Scanner. This might be it. We have to investigate that.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_scout_03: This is amazing. These plants are unlike anything that I've ever seen before. The temperature around them is much below the freezing temperature of water.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_scout_04: The chemical compounds that are secreted by these plants react with the volcanic gases that are present here. This reaction sucks enormous amounts of energy from the space around it, resulting in very rapid cooling of its surroundings. It's an astonishing survival mechanism.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_scout_05: We should try to replicate this effect. We have to gather enough samples of this plant to research it in our lab. We can do that by cutting them down or by using the Bioscanner.
dialog/story/magma/ashley_scout_06: Let's do this as soon as possible. If we can learn to replicate this effect, then we should be able to move freely around this biome.
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_new_resourc: Rift jump successful. Warning! Nearby volcanic eruption detected. Watch out for falling debris.
Affirmative, I have enabled projectile hit prediction and am actively marking estimated collision locations. Evade these markers as soon as you see them. We only have a few seconds to act.

Ashley, the Orbital Scanner detected Titanium deposits hidden underground. If we can gather enough Titanium from this area, we should be able to study the geological composition of Titanium-rich ores present on this planet. The next logical step will be to establish a permanent Titanium mining outpost.
Mission accomplished. We've gathered enough Titanium to be able to study its geological presence patterns on Galatea 37.
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_rare_resour: Rift jump successful. The Orbital Scanner reported large condensations of Ferdonite in this area. We can harvest it from the blue entwined crystals that are growing here or try to locate it with the Geoscanner.

You can also use the Bioscanner to scan the blue entwined crystal formations. If we can gather enough samples of these crystals, then we will be able to learn how to obtain more Ferdonite. Maybe we could even grow it.
Ashley, I have located a significant condensation of Ferdonite near our position. I have marked its approximate location on our map.
Ashley, it appears that most of the Ferdonite is contained within these creatures. They are the source of my readings.

We need to gather more specimens from the blue entwined crystal formations in order to harvest Ferdonite directly from them. I can extract more data and resources from various objects after my AI subroutines familiarize themselves with more specimens. Maybe we could even grow these crystals after reaching a high enough familiarity level.

Ashley, we have gathered enough data about these crystals to start harvesting Ferdonite directly from them. If we could gather enough research specimens to reach the next Familiarity Level, then we could grow these crystals using a Cultivator.
Ashley, it appears that the Ferdonite deposit is located within this Krocoon nest...
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_samples_01: Rift jump successful. Gravitational anomaly detected. Gravitational strength 0.56G. Magnetic field anomaly detected. My sensors are receiving a lot of interference.
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_samples_02: Ashley, let's focus on finding the titanium deposit that should be somewhere in this area. We can triangulate its position by building a network of Radars.
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_samples_03: We can also construct CryoStations of our own. However, they require Titanium to be built. We can find small amounts of Titanium by harvesting CryoPlants.
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_samples_04: We will need a few additional radar stations to triangulate the position of the Titanium deposit. Try to place them as far from each other as possible. They need to cover a wide area.
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_samples_05: Ashley, we've constructed enough radar stations to locate the Titanium deposit. I am marking its approximate position on our map.
dialog/story/magma/mech_find_samples_06: It is enough to provide data for the Orbital Scanner to search for more significant deposits underground.
dialog/story/magma/mech_resource_outpost: Rift jump successful. I am detecting multiple, minable Titanium deposits in close proximity to our location.
Ashley, remember that in this biome, we have to cool the surroundings before placing any buildings. Start by constructing CryoStations in the location where you want to build your base.

We have to change our approach to generating energy in this outpost. The atmosphere in this biome is very dense. It is blocking sunlight and reducing the effectiveness of solar panels. Wind activity is also very low, so wind turbines don't produce much energy. However, I am detecting multiple geothermal vents and rich carbonium deposits. We can place power plants on these resources.
Ashley, let us not forget that we came here to start mining Titanium for our Rift Station. Remember to place rare element mines on the Titanium deposits that we've found here.
We have mined half of the Titanium that we need to finish constructing the Quantum Gate Stabilizer for the Rift Station. I am detecting increased activity amongst the local fauna.

Warning! I'm detecting a massive swarm of creatures heading towards our outpost. We still have some time to prepare. Strengthen our defenses as much as possible. This attack is going to be very strong.
I'm not detecting any large groups of creatures in the vicinity of our base. We fended off the attack.
We have gathered enough Titanium to construct the Quantum Gate Stabilizer. We should return to HQ to start the construction process.
dialog/story/magma/mech_scout_01: Rift jump successful. Warning, temperature above safety levels. This area is hotter than we expected. My armor is going to sustain damage from the heat.
dialog/story/magma/mech_scout_02: Ashley, I'm detecting multiple temperature anomalies close to our position. It looks like my sensors are broken. The temperature suddenly drops in these areas by hundreds of degrees.
dialog/story/magma/mech_scout_03: Ashley, move in closer to this plant. We can study it from up close and cool off in its aura.
dialog/story/magma/mech_scout_04: We can use this effect to our advantage. The space around these plants is safe for us, so we can use it to regenerate while moving around this biome.
dialog/story/magma/mech_scout_05: I would strongly suggest using the Bioscanner. It is much more effective at gathering usable samples, and it will not destroy our safety zones.
dialog/story/magma/mech_scout_06: We've gathered enough samples to study these cryo plants in our Alien Research Laboratory.
dialog/story/outro_1_houston_01: Congratulations Riftbreaker Nowak! You’ve secured Galatea 37 for colonization. This is a huge step forward for all of humanity. Our expeditionary forces can start building up a colony.
dialog/story/outro_1_houston_02: This planet has an abundance of natural resources that will enable our civilization to thrive for centuries to come. Your bravery and persistence will serve as an inspiration for future generations of Riftbreakers.
dialog/story/outro_1_houston_03: The galaxy is full of planets that are waiting to be discovered and explored. Our new home on Galatea 37 will allow us to go further than we have ever gone before.
dialog/story/outro_2_ashley_02: Opening the portal would only lead to the destruction of this planet. The creatures that we’ve been fighting were only trying to protect their home.
dialog/story/outro_2_ashley_03: Humanity is just like these creatures. It’s an apex predator trying to survive by devouring other species, constantly expanding its territory.
dialog/story/outro_2_ashley_04: We can’t stop humanity from colonizing this planet. But we can take more time to study it. To learn how to preserve as much as we can and how to coexist.
dialog/story/outro_2_mech_03: They will send someone else to complete this task.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_01: The preparations we made were demanding. Every Megastructure, every modification, every upgrade pushed us to the edge of what was possible. But it worked.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_02: When the portal to Earth finally opened, I was able to convince Riftbreaker Command that a large-scale pacification force was not needed.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_03: Instead, they sent engineers and researchers - not soldiers. Builders, not conquerors.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_04: The Arcology Project gave the first settlers something no colonization mission ever had before: time.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_05: Time to study the planet, time to understand it, time to choose where to live without destroying what was already here.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_06: Technology became the bridge between two worlds - humans and Galatea - working together, not against each other.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_07: I am proud of what we accomplished here.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_08: The extra effort paid off, and maybe, just maybe, we proved there is a better way to reach for the stars.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_09: It is time for me to close this chapter and move on.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_10: Galatea 37 has a future now - and so do I.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_ashley_11: Let's see what's waiting for us beyond the next portal.
dialog/story/outro_endgame_mech_01: Adventure never waits, Ashley. Neither should we.
dialog/survival/ashley_desert_entry_01: This biome is much less welcoming than the Tropical Zone. It's full of radiation, and there's practically no wind here. We'll have to rely on solar power, at least in the beginning.
dialog/survival/ashley_final_wave_finish: I can't believe it. This was so intense that I'm still shaking. It's hard to say if this is true or if I'm still within a simulation.
Wow, this was intense, but we could probably survive a more challenging final attack.
Amazing. I don't know how we survived through that onslaught, but we did. You're amazing, Mr. Riggs.
How did we ever live through that? That final attack looked absolutely impossible to withstand. Now I feel that we can survive anything.
dialog/survival/ashley_final_wave_prepar: This is it. We've defended our base long enough to initiate the final Rift opening sequence at the Headquarters. The Rift is going to send out intense energy waves at a large distance. It's going to provoke the strongest attack yet. We have to prepare as much as possible and defend the HQ at all costs. If that building is destroyed during the charge-up phase, it's going to result in a nuclear fission explosion. Either we survive, or it's game over. There's nothing in between.
dialog/survival/houston_final_wave_finis: Wake up, captain Nowak. Combat simulation is over. You did well here. Let's hope that this will be enough for Galatea 37.
Well done, Nowak. You did well, but this won't be enough to survive on Galatea 37. I want to see you run this course with higher parameters.
That was an exceptional show of combat skills, captain Nowak. You amazed us again. There's not much more anyone could have survived.
That's unbelievable. It shouldn't be possible to survive through that onslaught. Somebody failed designing this simulation. Congratulations, Nowak, you are the best there ever was.
dialog/survival/mech_desert_entry_01: Ashley, remember to watch out for quicksand. You'll have to place Extra Stable Floor over it to prevent our buildings from sinking.
dialog/survival/mech_final_wave_finished: The Rift is stabilizing. Creature count has been minimized. Congratulations Ashley. We did it.
dialog/weather/ashley_acid_fissures_end_: The eruption is over. The situation is stabilizing.
dialog/weather/ashley_acid_fissures_star: The ground is opening up in some places and it's spewing strong acidic clouds. The acid is going to corrode everything within it's range.
The ground is opening up. Watch out for corrosive gas.
dialog/weather/ashley_acid_fissures_warn: I can feel the ground shaking and my scanners are detecting small eruptions of acidic gasses. I think an acidic eruption is coming
My sensors are indicating an imminent release of acidic gases.
dialog/weather/ashley_acid_rain_end_01: The acid rain is over. Let's get our base back in shape.
dialog/weather/ashley_acid_rain_start_01: It's raining acid. It's going to corrode and damage our buildings.
dialog/weather/ashley_acid_rain_warning_: I'm seeing very dark and heavy clouds on the horizon. Their composition suggests acid rain is coming. We have to prepare quickly. We won't be able to build anything while it's raining.
I'm seeing very dark and heavy clouds on the horizon. Acid rain is coming.
dialog/weather/ashley_ash_clouds_end_01: The ash clouds have dispersed now. Air visibility is back to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_ash_clouds_start_0: The sky is covered in ash and dust. Our Solar Panels are useless now.
dialog/weather/ashley_ash_clouds_warning: There's a dense ash cloud on the horizon. It's coming our way. It's going to get dark soon.
A dense ash cloud is coming our way.
dialog/weather/ashley_blizzard_end_01: I can see again. That blizzard’s over.
dialog/weather/ashley_blizzard_end_02: The snow’s letting up. Let’s get back to work.
dialog/weather/ashley_blizzard_start_01: The storm’s here. I can barely see anything out there.
dialog/weather/ashley_blizzard_start_02: Alright, this just turned into a serious snowstorm.
dialog/weather/ashley_blizzard_warning_0: Temperature’s dropping fast. This might turn into a blizzard.
I don’t like the look of those clouds. Feels like a blizzard’s on the way.
dialog/weather/ashley_blood_moon_end_01: The blood moon is over. Things are getting back to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_blood_moon_start_0: Everything is glowing red. This atmosphere reminds me of how I lost my arm. It's unsettling.
This lighting makes me feel uneasy. I get a bad feeling about this.
dialog/weather/ashley_blood_moon_warning: There's a red moon coming up on the horizon. I'm getting a bad feeling about this.
dialog/weather/ashley_blooming_air_end_0: The air is getting back to normal. The sudden bloom event has ended.
dialog/weather/ashley_blooming_air_start: The air is blooming. Vegetation has started to grow like crazy around us.
There's so much pollen in the air. Vegetation started growing like crazy.
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_hail_end_01: The hail storm is over. Phew. These ice pellets were much larger than anything on Earth.
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_hail_end_01_s: The hail storm is over. Phew.
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_hail_start_01: We're getting bombarded by really large hail. It's even damaging Mr. Riggs' armor.
We're getting bombarded by really large hail.
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_hail_warning_: The atmosphere is condensing. It looks like a weather anomaly is going to hit us in a moment.
We'd better watch out - a hail storm is coming.
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_moon_end_01: The blue moon is over. Sights like this are why I became a Riftbreaker.
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_moon_end_01_s: The moon is back to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_moon_start_01: A blue moon is up. I wonder if this affects the local fauna...
dialog/weather/ashley_blue_moon_warning_: The sky is getting blue-ish. This is something you won't see on Earth.
We might see a blue moon tonight.
dialog/weather/ashley_cave_in_start_01: A part of the cave system has just collapsed.
dialog/weather/ashley_cave_in_start_02: Some parts of the cave system have just collapsed. I hope that the ceiling above us doesn't fall one day.
dialog/weather/ashley_cave_in_warning_01: I am sensing slight tremors. I think a cave-in is imminent. We should watch out for falling rocks.
dialog/weather/ashley_cavein_start_01: A cave-in is happening nearby. It's going to block some tunnels.
dialog/weather/ashley_cavein_start_02: The ceiling has collapsed nearby. This could block some passages.
dialog/weather/ashley_cavein_warning_01: The cave is rumbling. We should expect a cave-in soon.
dialog/weather/ashley_cavein_warning_02: I can hear distant cracks echoing through the caverns. There's a cave-in coming.
dialog/weather/ashley_crystal_growth_fin: Nice! It's a large mineral deposit. We can harvest these crystals.
Wow, these crystals must have grown here in a matter of seconds. They are very rich in resources, we should harvest them.
dialog/weather/ashley_dust_storm_end_01: The weather is clearing up. I can see everything again. Let's hope this doesn't happen again too soon.
dialog/weather/ashley_dust_storm_end_01_: It looks like the dust storm is over.
dialog/weather/ashley_dust_storm_start_0: The sky is barely visible now and dust is getting everywhere. I hate dust storms.
dialog/weather/ashley_dust_storm_warning: The wind is picking up. There's a dense dust storm visible on the horizon.
There's a dense dust storm visible on the horizon.
dialog/weather/ashley_earthquake_end_01: The earthquake is over. The tremors are getting weaker and weaker. We should quickly repair whatever's been damaged.
dialog/weather/ashley_earthquake_end_01_: The earthquake has stopped. Lat's assess the damage.
dialog/weather/ashley_earthquake_start_0: It's an earthquake! It's going to seriously damage all buildings near it's epicenter.
dialog/weather/ashley_earthquake_warning: I'm sensing slight tremors. They are intensifying over time. It looks like an earthquake is coming.
It looks like an earthquake is coming.
dialog/weather/ashley_fireflies_start_04: Galatean fireflies are spectacular. We're in for a show tonight.
dialog/weather/ashley_firestorm_end_01: The firestom is over. Everything is getting back to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_firestorm_start_01: We're in a firestorm. It's not going to harm us directly, but it can ignite vegetation.
It's a firestorm. Vegetation is starting to ignite.
dialog/weather/ashley_firestorm_start_ou: A firestorm is raging around us. Solar panels will have to be closed for its duration, but we can get extra power from wind turbines.
dialog/weather/ashley_firestorm_warning_: An intense heatwave is coming our way. Prepare for a firestorm.
dialog/weather/ashley_fog_end_01: The fog is clearing up. This will make things easier for us.
dialog/weather/ashley_fog_start_01: It's hard to see anything in this fog. It's also affecting our Solar Panels and Wind Turbines. We have to wait it out.
dialog/weather/ashley_fog_start_01_short: It's hard to see anything in this fog.
dialog/weather/ashley_fog_warning_01: Wind is slowing down. The air is getting dense. A fog is forming up.
dialog/weather/ashley_fog_warning_01_sho: A fog is expected to form up shortly.
dialog/weather/ashley_heavy_snow_end_02: Looks like the weather’s clearing up.
dialog/weather/ashley_heavy_snow_start_0: Light snow and some wind. Could be worse.
Snow’s falling now. Wind’s kicking up, but it’s manageable.
dialog/weather/ashley_heavy_snow_warning: The air’s cooling off. Feels like snow’s coming.
Clouds are rolling in, and the wind’s picking up a bit.
dialog/weather/ashley_ice_falling_rocks_: That was brutal. I can’t believe how much ice came down.
The sky’s clearing. That was way worse than a blizzard.
That’s not snow! Huge chunks of ice are falling out of the clouds!
Those clouds are dropping massive slabs of ice! Take cover!
The clouds are turning solid. Looks like we’re about to get ice falling from the sky.
That doesn’t look like normal weather. Big pieces of ice are forming up above us.
dialog/weather/ashley_ice_tornado_end_01: The wind’s finally calming down. That was rough.
dialog/weather/ashley_ice_tornado_end_02: Looks like it’s over. I don’t want to see that again anytime soon.
dialog/weather/ashley_ice_tornado_start_: A large snow devil has just finished forming! We have to stay away from its path.
A snow devil is moving our way! These things hit way harder than they look!
dialog/weather/ashley_ice_tornado_warnin: I’m seeing snow whip into tight spirals. This could get dangerous.
The wind’s getting violent. That snow’s starting to spin hard.
dialog/weather/ashley_ion_storm_end_01: Everything is getting back to normal. Thankfully this didn't last long.
dialog/weather/ashley_ion_storm_start_01: This ion storm is really intense. It disabled a lot of equipment. We have to wait it off.
The ion storm is disabling our equipment.
dialog/weather/ashley_ion_storm_warning_: There's an intense aurora in the sky. Prepare for an ion storm. It's going to disable a lot of equipment.
dialog/weather/ashley_meteor_shower_end_: The rock rain is over. That was intense...
dialog/weather/ashley_meteor_shower_star: These rocks can do some serious damage. Evasive manouvers Mr Riggs!
dialog/weather/ashley_meteor_shower_warn: I'm tracking a swarm of fast moving objects across the sky. It's a meteor shower. Prepare for bomardment.
I'm tracking a meteor shower on a collision course with us.
dialog/weather/ashley_monsoon_start_01: The rain is pouring down. It may take a while before it stops.
dialog/weather/ashley_monsoon_start_outp: The monsoon rainfall will force our solar panels to shut down, but wind power generation will increase.
dialog/weather/ashley_monsoon_warning_01: Monsoon winds are blowing from the sea. Heavy rain is expected.
dialog/weather/ashley_no_wind_end_01: The wind is coming back. Wind power is returning to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_no_wind_end_01_sho: Wind power is returning to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_no_wind_start_01: All wind has stopped. Our Wind Turbines are down.
dialog/weather/ashley_no_wind_warning_01: The weather's changing. Wind is slowing down.
dialog/weather/ashley_rain_end_01: The rain is over. Turns out that some things are not as different as back on Earth.
dialog/weather/ashley_rain_start_01: It's raining. It will decrease the output from Solar Panels until it stops.
dialog/weather/ashley_rain_warning_01: It's getting cloudy. It looks like it's going to rain.
dialog/weather/ashley_resource_comet_end: It's hit the ground. Let's head there quickly and see what we can learn.
dialog/weather/ashley_resource_comet_sta: We've calculated the comet's possible impact location. It's flying right above us. We have to investigate it as soon as it hits the ground.
The comet will hit the surface soon. We have to investigate it.
dialog/weather/ashley_resource_comet_war: A small comet piece has entered the atmosphere very close to our position. It looks like it's coming our way.
A small piece of a comet is going to hit close to our position..
dialog/weather/ashley_resource_earthquak: Hey Mr Riggs, we're lucky today. It's a new resource deposit.
The earthquake opened up the ground. I'm detecting a small gravitational anomaly near our base. We should investigate it.
It seems like the earthquake has uncovered something interesting. Let's investigate.
The ground is shaking. It looks like an earthquake is coming.
It looks like an earthquake is coming.
dialog/weather/ashley_rock_rain_end_01: The sky is getting clear. The danger is over.
dialog/weather/ashley_rock_rain_start_01: We're getting hit by volcanic bombs. There's rock raining from the sky.
We're getting hit by volcanic bombs.
dialog/weather/ashley_rock_rain_warning_: I'm hearing some loud distant explosions. A nearby volcano has just exploded. My radar is tracking a cloud of fast moving objects heading our way. Prepare for bombardment!
A nearby volcano has just exploded. Prepare for bombardment!
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_burn_end_01: Solar radiation is getting back to normal. The Sun Burn is over.
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_burn_end_01_: Solar radiation is getting back to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_burn_positiv: The sun’s flaring up. Radiation levels are climbing.
I am getting some serious solar output readings. A Solar Burn is coming.
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_burn_start_0: The Sun is burning our armor and structures. Hopefully this will not last long.
The Sun is burning our armor and structures.
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_burn_warning: The Sun is very intense today and it's still intensifying. There's no atmospheric shielding in this desert. It's going to start dealing serious damage soon.
The Sun's activity is at an extreme today, it might be dangerous.
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_eclipse_end_: Galatea's solar system is quite a busy place. It looks like these eclipses may happen more often.
The eclipse is over. Solar Panels are back online.
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_eclipse_star: It's totally dark now... in the middle of the day. Fortunately this shouldn't last long.
One of Galatea's moons has blocked the sun completely.
dialog/weather/ashley_solar_eclipse_warn: It's slowly getting dark. It looks like there's a solar eclipse starting right now.
dialog/weather/ashley_stalactytes_start_: The roof is falling! Evasive maneouvers Mr. Riggs!
Run Mr. Riggs! The cave is falling down on us.
dialog/weather/ashley_stalactytes_warnin: Oh no! The crystals above us are moving. The're going to fall in a moment.
The roof above us is shaking. It's going to fall any minute.
dialog/weather/ashley_strong_wind_end_01: The wind is calming down. Wind Turbine power output is coming back to normal.
dialog/weather/ashley_strong_wind_start_: These strong winds can make our life easier. Wind Turbines are spinning like crazy.
The wind is much stronger than usual!
dialog/weather/ashley_strong_wind_warnin: The wind is picking up speed. Loose objects are starting to fly.
The wind is picking up speed.
dialog/weather/ashley_super_moon_end_01: The moon is setting down. We're getting back to the usual darkness.
dialog/weather/ashley_super_moon_start_0: The moon is fully up. It's shinning so bright that even our Solar Panels can charge up a bit.
dialog/weather/ashley_super_moon_warning: A new celestial event is starting. One of Galatea's moons is going to shine like crazy tonight.
We're going to have a supermoon tonight.
dialog/weather/ashley_thunderstorm_end_0: The storm is over, it's so quiet all of a sudden.
dialog/weather/ashley_thunderstorm_start: The storm is getting really intense. I hope it doesn't overload our power grid.
The storm is getting really intense.
dialog/weather/ashley_thunderstorm_warni: I can hear distant thunder. The wind is also picking up. A storm is coming.
The wind is picking up. A storm is coming.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_acid_end_0: The acid tornado is gone. I hope we won't see that phenomenon too often.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_acid_start: Watch out, Mr. Riggs. An acidic tornado has just formed close to our location. It's wrecking everything in its path.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_acid_warni: I am seeing heavy acidic clouds moving fast on the horizon. They can form into a tornado.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_end_01: The tornado is gone. Thankfuly it didn't last that long.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_fire_end_0: The air is cooling off. I think such events shouldn't happen that often. I hope they don't.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_fire_start: We have a flaming tornado wreaking havoc close to our position. It's extremely dangerous!
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_fire_warni: We have extreme weather on the horizon. I see a raging firestorm that's heading straight for a storm cloud.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_start_01: The tornado is destroying everything in its path. Let's move out of its way and repair what we can.
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_start_01_s: The tornado is destroying everything in its path!
dialog/weather/ashley_tornado_warning_01: The weather is changing, there's a tornado on the horizon. It's heading straight for us.

dialog/weather/ashley_weak_wind_end_01: Wind is picking up again. Power generation is getting back to normal.

dialog/weather/ashley_weak_wind_warning_: It looks like the weather is calming down. Wind is getting slower.
dialog/weather/mech_acid_fissures_end_01: The acidic gas is dispersing. This eruption is over. It's hard to say how often these may happen.

dialog/weather/mech_acid_fissures_warnin: Warning! I'm detecting an imminent acid eruption. Ashley, prepare yourself!

dialog/weather/mech_ash_clouds_end_01: The atmosphere is clearing up. Base operations returning to nominal levels.
dialog/weather/mech_ash_clouds_start_01: The ash cloud is upon us. Visibility is down and air temperature is up. You wouldn't want to breathe this. Solar Panels are disabled as well.

dialog/weather/mech_ash_clouds_warning_0: Ashley, I'm detecting increased volcanic activity. There's a dense ash cloud coming our way.

dialog/weather/mech_blue_moon_start_01_s: The blue moon is up. Local creatures are calmer than usual.
dialog/weather/mech_blue_moon_warning_01: Ashley, a unique phonomena is starting. One of Galatea's moons is starting to emit blue light. I can't predict the effects of this event.

dialog/weather/mech_cave_in_start_01: Warning. A part of the cave system has just collapsed.
dialog/weather/mech_cave_in_start_02: Warning. There was a cave-in in some parts of the cave system. Thankfully the rock structure above us appears to be stable.

Warning! Meteor shower expected to hit our location soon.

dialog/weather/mech_rain_warning_01: Air humidity is rising. It's going to rain in a moment.

The comet might bring us something valuable. I'm tracking its position.

Warning! The ceiling above us is becoming unstable.
dialog/weather/mech_strong_wind_end_01: Wind speed is returning back to typical values. Wind Turbine efficiency returning to normal.
dialog/weather/mech_strong_wind_start_01: Wind speed is at an exceptional high. Wind Turbine efficiency is at maximum.
dialog/weather/mech_strong_wind_warning_: Weather conditions are changing. Wind speed is increasing.

dialog/weather/mech_super_moon_start_01: The "supermoon" is fully visible in the sky. It's light is strong enough to charge our Solar Panels.
dialog/weather/mech_super_moon_warning_0: This night is going to be much brighter than usual. It should make surving it a little easier.

dialog/weather/mech_thunderstorm_start_0: The storm is very violent, but our base is safe from the wind. Wind Turbine output is at maximum levels.

gui/hud/benchmark_results.title: Benchmark results: ${benchmark_name}
gui/hud/big_map/click_to_teleport: <img="gui/hud/keys/key_513"> Click on a <img="gui/menu/gui_map_icon_headquarter">/<img="gui/menu/gui_map_icon_rift">/<img="gui/hud/minimap_icons/gui_map_icon_player"> icon to instantly teleport to its destination.
gui/hud/building_description/ai_hub: Provides AI Cores that are required to manage more buildings with artificial intelligence like Sentinel Towers or the Repair Facility.
gui/hud/building_description/ammunition_: Automatically gathers and stores ammunition. It expands the global storage space for all ammunition.
gui/hud/building_description/animal_biom: Produces energy out of Animal Biomass from fallen enemies.
gui/hud/building_description/arcology_wo: Enables the construction of Arcologies - self-sufficient structures capable of sustaining life in any environment.
gui/hud/building_description/armory: Allows crafting of new weapons and items. Automatically produces and instantly transports ammunition and supplies to the Mecha-Suit.
gui/hud/building_description/base_lamp: Provides light during night time, must be connected to the energy grid.
gui/hud/building_description/bio_compost: Produces Flammable Gas out of Plant Biomass.
gui/hud/building_description/bio_condens: This building extracts biomass from mud, leaving the organic remains behind. They are later fermented and turned into sludge.
gui/hud/building_description/carbonium_f: Produces Carbonium. Must be placed on a Carbonium Ore deposit and powered with Energy to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/carbonium_p: Must be built on top of a Carbonium Ore deposit. Provides good power output but uses up resources from the deposit. Can use only unrefined Carbonium straight from the ground.
gui/hud/building_description/carbonium_s: Synthesizes Carbonium from Energy. Can be used as an infinite source of Carbonium but consumes a lot of energy in the process which makes it not very economical.
gui/hud/building_description/communicati: Allows communicating with Earth via quantum entanglement and downloading schematics for buildings and upgrades. Enables research. Transmission is instant regardless of distance but has very low bandwidth.
gui/hud/building_description/cryo_statio: A self-powered rapid environment cooling station. This building can be placed to quickly reduce the temperature in very hot environments to enable other structures to be built.
gui/hud/building_description/crystal_col: Sends out automatic drones that gather crystal resources in a radius around the building.
gui/hud/building_description/crystal_lam: The Crystal Lamp is a unique and elegant decorative item that utilizes fluorescent crystals found in the caverns of Galatea 37.
gui/hud/building_description/crystal_str: These buildings utilize crystals synthesized from samples gathered during the Galatea 37 mission. They can be used to decorate your base.
gui/hud/building_description/drone_mine: The Drone Mine is a hub for a fleet of automated drones that will collect solid resources of all varieties within the operating radius of the Mine.
gui/hud/building_description/energy_conn: Connects buildings to the power grid within its operational radius.
gui/hud/building_description/energy_pylo: The Energy Relay system allows the Riftbreaker to transfer energy over long distances without the use of Energy Connectors. At least two pylons are necessary for this technology to work properly.
gui/hud/building_description/energy_stor: Stores a significant amount of energy. Best used with intermittent power sources like Solar Panels to create an energy buffer.
gui/hud/building_description/eraser_tool: This tool allows the Mecha-Suit to enter floor removal mode.
gui/hud/building_description/floor_acid: This is a corrosion resistant version of the floor. It protects base buildings from acid corrosion  like the one caused by Acidic Yeast Colonies
gui/hud/building_description/floor_concr: Basic concrete floor. Increases movement speed of the Mecha-suit and looks better than sand and rocks.
gui/hud/building_description/floor_decor: Decorative floor for your base. Increases movement speed of the Mecha-suit and looks better than sand and rocks.
gui/hud/building_description/floor_defau: Basic metal floor. Increases movement speed of the Mecha-suit and looks better than sand and rocks.
gui/hud/building_description/floor_deser: This version of the floor provides extra stability for the base buildings. It allows buildings to be built on top of quick sand.
gui/hud/building_description/floor_steam: Floor with a Steam logo. Increases movement speed of the Mecha-suit and looks better than sand and rocks.
gui/hud/building_description/flora_colle: Sends out automatic drones that gather alien flora in a radius around the building. This process generates all kinds of resources depending on what was gathered.
gui/hud/building_description/fusion_fiel: Creates a powerful nuclear fusion field that accelerates condensed hyper particles to faster than light speed. Super charged hyper particles contained within a controlled magnetic field become the fabric of the quantum gate portal.
gui/hud/building_description/fusion_powe: Very large energy output. Produces plasma resource as a byproduct.
gui/hud/building_description/future_city: Riftbreakers can use these decorative structures to make their bases feel more like home. These buildings capture all the newest urban architecture trends from Earth.
gui/hud/building_description/gas_extract: Place this structure on top of a Gas Vent to extinguish it and start collecting the Flammable Gas escaping from beneath the ground.
gui/hud/building_description/gas_filteri: Refines Sludge to produce Flammable Gas which is used as fuel by the Gas Powerplants. Requires a constant flow of sludge that can be connected by using pipelines.
gui/hud/building_description/gas_powerpl: Produces a significant amount of energy but requires Flammable Gas to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/geothermal_: Must be built on top of a Geothermal Vent. Produces significant amounts of energy.
gui/hud/building_description/gravitation: Enables the construction of gigantic structures in zero-gravity environments. Allows for object detection through geomagnetic mapping.
gui/hud/building_description/headquarter: The central building in your base. It allows the Mecha-Suit to reconstruct, includes a rift portal and provides storage facilities. Protect this building at any cost.
gui/hud/building_description/hedge: A decorative wall that can be used to divide sections of the base, wall off gardens, or create mazes.
gui/hud/building_description/hitech_stru: Synthetic structures first observed in the Metallic Valley biome. Adapted for decorative purposes to give your base a futuristic look.
gui/hud/building_description/hydroponic_: Conducts research and development of modified flora. Greatly increases vegetation growth speed within the location it is built in.
gui/hud/building_description/hyper_parti: Generates and condenses dark matter hyper particles using an array of Palladium core quantum condensers.
gui/hud/building_description/ionizer: Produces Plasma out of other resources.
gui/hud/building_description/ironium_syn: Synthesizes Ironium using Energy. Can be used in an emergency situation when Ironium is depleted but Energy is abundant.
gui/hud/building_description/laboratory: Provides advanced research facilities that are required to develop technologies based on extreaterrestrial fauna and flora.
gui/hud/building_description/large_energ: Large Energy Storage is a high-capacity facility designed to store significant amounts of excess energy for later use.
gui/hud/building_description/large_solid: Large Solid Material Storage allows for long-term storage of large quantities of solid resources. It increases overall storage capacity and helps maintain stable supply chains for construction and production.
gui/hud/building_description/liquid_comp: This facility is used to compress liquid resources on a subatomic level to allow their transportation over long distances using the Rift Technology.
gui/hud/building_description/liquid_deco: The reception terminal for liquids transported using the Rift Technology. This facility restores the liquids treated by the Liquid Compressor to their original form.
gui/hud/building_description/liquid_mate: Stores a significant amount of liquid or gas. Can store only one type of resource at a time and needs to be connected with Pipelines to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/liquid_pump: Pumps liquid resources from pools found around the planet. Pumps can not operate too close to each other.
gui/hud/building_description/loot_collec: The Loot Collector Tower is a hub for automated drones that will scavenge all the resources and materials dropped within the tower's area of operation.
gui/hud/building_description/magma_power: Uses liquid Magma to produce large amounts of Energy. Needs to be connected to liquid Magma with Pipelines.
gui/hud/building_description/mast: Decorative flag for the Riftbreaker's base. Doesn't have any particular function except being a decoration.
gui/hud/building_description/mega_rift_s: Enables long-distance interplanetary rift jumps to a single destination. Produces a pair of Quantum Entanglement Cores.
gui/hud/building_description/mining_elev: The Mining Drill is a highly specialized building that allows the Riftbreaker to breach the layers of the planet's crust and safely reach levels below the surface.
gui/hud/building_description/morphium_po: This Power Plant captures the excess energy resulting from the nuclear synthesis and decay processes naturally occurring in Morphium. Provides the power grid with a steady flow of energy at a low upkeep cost.
gui/hud/building_description/nanobot_cen: Manages large nanobot construction swarms over long distances. Provides additional AI Cores in all planetary locations.
gui/hud/building_description/nuclear_pow: It has very large Energy output.
gui/hud/building_description/outpost: A miniature version of the Headquarters building. Can be constructed during planetary missions to transport resources from remote bases to the main base via rift technology. It allows the Mecha-Suit to reconstruct.
gui/hud/building_description/picker_tool: This tool allows you to pick a building that has already been built and then quickly build an another instance of it without browsing the build menu.
gui/hud/building_description/pipe_juncti: This structure allows the Riftbreaker to cross two pipelines that transport different types of liquid resources without mixing them up.
gui/hud/building_description/pipe_straig: Transports liquids, gasses and plasma. Used to connect various buildings that require a fuel source to operate. Can transport and store only one type or resource at a time.
gui/hud/building_description/planet_scan: Constantly scans the whole planet to detect valuable resources, artifacts, new species and other phenomena outside the main base area. Allows rift jumping to planetary missions.
gui/hud/building_description/plant_bioma: Produces energy out of Plant Biomass from destroyed foliage.
gui/hud/building_description/plasma_conv: Converts Plasma into Supercharged Plasma by using large amounts of energy.
gui/hud/building_description/portal: Creates a rift in spacetime allowing immediate travel to its location.
gui/hud/building_description/pot: Decorative plant for the Riftbreaker's base. Doesn't have any particular function except being a decoration.
gui/hud/building_description/quantum_cor: Advanced Quantum Computing datacenter. Enables reprocessing of megastructure schematics and greatly increases research speed.
gui/hud/building_description/quantum_gat: Required to stabilize the quantum gate that contains the actual rift portal. Without this component quantum gate malfunction may disintegrate the object entering the portal.
gui/hud/building_description/rare_elemen: Mines rare resources like Uranium, Titanium and Palladium. Must be placed on an ore deposit and powered with Energy to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/repair_faci: Repairs damaged buildings in a radius around this facility using automated drones.
gui/hud/building_description/repair_tool: This tool allows the Mecha-Suit to enter building repair mode. In this mode it is possible to repair multiple buildings simultaneously, without the need to attend to them one by one.
gui/hud/building_description/repellent_d: Repellent Drone Hub sends out specialized drones that spray the target area with a repellent substance according to the Riftbreaker's current needs.
gui/hud/building_description/research_st: This building contains a robust set of sensors and analysis facilities. It is used to gather research data from objects or anomalies that are too complicated to be scanned by Mr. Rigg's field equipment.
gui/hud/building_description/rift_magnet: Stabilizes the big rift portal. Needs Water or Supercoolant to operate.
Stabilizes the big rift portal with alien based tech. More advanced than standard version. Does not need cooling.
gui/hud/building_description/rift_statio: This is the big rift that can connect planets in different parts of the galaxy. Can open a rift back to Earth.
gui/hud/building_description/scifi_struc: These futuristic, high-tech structures can be used to give your base an entirely new look.
gui/hud/building_description/seismic_lab: This building contains very precise seismographic equipment that collects data for large-scale geological analysis of the area. Needs a constant supply of water for cooling purposes.
gui/hud/building_description/sell_tool: This tool allows the Mecha-Suit to enter building selling mode. Every building selected while the tool is active will be sold. The materials will be transported back to storage.
gui/hud/building_description/shield_gene: Adds shield protection to all structures in a radius.
gui/hud/building_description/short_range: Provides radar coverage and enables defense towers to shoot beyond their viewing range. Detects hostile entities and shows them on the map. Great for spotting incoming attacks.
gui/hud/building_description/solar_panel: Provides Energy during the day hours. Shuts down automatically during the night, or when the sun is not visible e.g. during intense storms.
gui/hud/building_description/solid_mater: Automatically gathers (using rift technology) and stores solid materials. It expands the global storage space for all solid materials.
gui/hud/building_description/statue: Decorative statue for the Riftbreaker's base. Doesn't have any particular function except being a decoration.
gui/hud/building_description/steel_facto: Produces Ironium. Must be placed on Iron Ore deposits.
gui/hud/building_description/supercoolan: Produces Supercoolant resource for advanced buildings.
gui/hud/building_description/switch_tool: This tool allows you to switch single or multiple buildings on or off. It can help with power management in situations when your power grid is under heavy load.
gui/hud/building_description/test_dummy_: This structure will allow you to test the combat effectiveness of your weapons, as well as your base defenses. Upon installation, it will be treated as an enemy unit.
This structure will allow you to test the combat effectiveness of your weapons. However, it won't be recognized as hostile by your base defenses.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_aa_ba: Basic Anti Air Defensive Tower. Shoots high speed energy projectiles at a limited rate of fire. Each shot consumes Energy from the main energy supply.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_acid_: Acid Shredder Tower is a rapid-fire defense structure that saturates nearby targets with corrosive acid projectiles. It excels at eliminating large groups of small enemies thanks to projectiles splitting on impact and hitting multiple targets at once.
This defensive tower covers the ground with highly concentrated hydrofluoric acid. The acid will damage any organic matter that comes into contact with it.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_alien: A defensive tower based on the Morphium technology. The unique properties of Morphium eliminate any additional power and AI requirements. Additionally, this tower can be placed directly on liquid pools.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_artil: Shoots explosive shells at long distances. Very effective against groups of enemies. Can shoot farther than its viewing range. Requires a Tower Ammunition Factory to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_basic: Basic defensive tower. Shoots high speed energy projectiles at a limited rate of fire.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_drone: Spawns defensive drones which hoover in the tower's operational radius and attack all enemies that come in range.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_flame: Sprays burning fluid. Short range but very effective against numerous small enemies. Requires a Tower Ammunition Factory to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_gatli: A large, energy-based defensive tower. Rapidly shoots powerful plasma projectiles. Its high stopping power comes at a cost of significant energy consumption.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_hcm: A silo, housing a massive rocket launched vertically and aimed at distant targets. Once the rocket reaches destination, it releases multiple explosive devices that cover a very large area. Gas supply required.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_heavy: Shoots mini nuke explosive shells at very long distances. Can protect the base from enemies shooting from a long distance. Use with Radars to shoot farther than its viewing range.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_icicl: Icicle Tower fires ice projectiles that deal cryo damage and significantly slow down enemies. It is effective at controlling enemy movement and reducing the pressure from advancing waves.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_infer: Inferno Tower fires cluster grenades that split into smaller payloads while airborne. After landing, they detonate with a short delay, setting targets on fire and dealing sustained damage over an area.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_laser: Shoots a constant beam of energy at a target. The beam gets more powerful while constantly hitting the target so its best used against large and heavily armored units.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_light: The weaponized electromagnet embedded within this tower creates an enormous disparity between itself and all organic matter around it. Thanks to that, it can create a powerful, but controllable electric arc that can affect multiple attackers.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_mine_: Spawns mines in the area of operation which in time create a mine field that is very hard for enemies to go through.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_minig: Minigun version of the base tower. Very high fire rate makes it effective against a wide range of enemies.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_plasm: Shoots high powered energy projectiles with a decent fire rate. It's quite universal and can defend your base against creatures that are resistant to physical damage. Uses energy to shoot so can be a good diversification if your tower ammo production is struggling to keep up.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_porta: Using a short-range Rift Portal, this defensive tower will deliver an armed warhead, prioritizing long-range hostile units. Thanks to instant delivery of the payload, this tower circumvents the problems connected with conventional artillery use.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_power: The Power Rod Tower launches long-range warheads. Upon reaching the target, a Power Rod emerges from the warhead. It produces high-voltage electric arcs, damaging nearby units.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_railg: Shoots a really powerful, piercing energy beam. Very low fire rate. Each shot consumes a significant portion of Energy from the main energy supply.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_rocke: Shoots explosive rockets at the enemies. Best used against groups of enemies or creatures that are vulnerable to area damage.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_shock: Emits powerful waves that freeze and damages enemies in a radius. Very good for slowing down enemy hordes and against creates vulnerable to cryo damage.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_shotg: This tower utilizes High-Caliber Tower Ammo. It rapidly shoots short-ranged volleys of small projectiles. It is very effective against large groups of small attackers.
gui/hud/building_description/tower_water: Projectiles from this tower set their targets on fire, dealing both contact damage and damage over time. It's precise and has long range, but has to be built on liquid surface.

Floating Piercer Tower shoots long range projectiles that pierce multiple targets and explode on final impact with a massive blast. All targets are dealt cryo damage and get significantly slowed down. Must be built on a liquid surface.
gui/hud/building_description/trap_acid: Once this trap is activated, it will spray atomized hydrofluoric acid in its vicinity. Can only be activated a limited number of times before it needs to be replaced.
gui/hud/building_description/trap_area: Uses a gravitational wave generator to create small fluctuations of the gravity field around itself to deal damage in a small area. Can only be activated a limited number of times before it needs to be replaced.
gui/hud/building_description/trap_cryo: This trap releases liquid nitrogen upon activation, immediately freezing all matter in its vicinity. Can only be activated a limited number of times before it needs to be replaced.
gui/hud/building_description/trap_energy: When a hostile creature activates this trap, a large number of free electrons is released, bringing imbalance to the static electric fields in the surrounding area and causing violent electric discharges. Can only be activated a limited number of times before it needs to be replaced.
gui/hud/building_description/trap_fire: Upon activation by a hostile creature, this trap sprays napalm all over the surrounding area, causing organic matter to catch fire and take fire damage. Can only be activated a limited number of times before it needs to be replaced.
gui/hud/building_description/trap_physic: Once this trap is activated, it will activate its razor-sharp spinning blades that are able to cut through most organic matter that comes into contact with them. Can only be activated a limited number of times before it needs to be replaced.
gui/hud/building_description/upgrade_too: This tool allows Mr. Riggs to enter building upgrade mode. While it's active, Mr. Riggs will apply the next available level of upgrades to selected buildings.
gui/hud/building_description/uranium_cen: Refines Uranium Ore. Produces Uranium for use in powerplants and crafting.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_crysta: A defensive wall made from synthesized crystals found in the depths of the Galatean cavern network. When destroyed, the wall will shatter and its shards will damage the nearby creatures.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_energy: An advanced form of a wall. Instead of relying on a solid structure, this version utilizes high-power laser beams to form a barrier. Coming into contact with this structure may be harmful.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_gate: Opens automatically when the Mecha-Suit is in close proximity. Doesn't require Energy to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_gate_c: An innovative defensive gate composed of synthesized crystals sourced from the subterranean depths of Galatea 37. Synthetic crystals break into jagged shards that inflict significant damage on any nearby hostiles when the building is destroyed.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_gate_e: An advanced form of a gate. Instead of relying on a solid structure, this version utilizes high-power laser beams to form a barrier. Coming into contact with this structure may be harmful.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_small: Provides basic protection for the base. Can be built in multiple layers. Cheap, reliable and sturdy.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_small_: Provides a higher defense position for the Mecha-Suit allowing it to shoot above walls and defend the base from inside of the walls.
gui/hud/building_description/wall_vine: These walls automatically recede into the ground when the Mech is close to them. This allows the user to shoot over them with ease and negates the need for building gates. The walls also regenerate missing hit points over time, but do not reconstruct from ruins by themselves.
gui/hud/building_description/water_filte: Purifies contaminated fluids like mud and produces clean water. Requires Energy to operate.
gui/hud/building_description/weather_con: Predicts extreme weather conditions and allows to control them to a certain extent.
gui/hud/building_description/wind_turbin: Provides a limited amount of energy depending on wind strength.

gui/loading/tooltip_01: Press <img="${upgrade_modifier}"> while building to quickly change the selected building's level.
gui/loading/tooltip_02: Some weapons will fire continuously when you hold the trigger. Others have an alternative, charged shot. You can check if the weapon has a charged mode on the inventory screen.
gui/loading/tooltip_03: Weather effects and the day and night cycle can severely affect your renewable energy sources, such as solar panels and wind turbines. Use energy storage to save energy for times when your power production is limited. The solar and wind power efficiency is displayed in the bottom-right corner, below the minimap.
gui/loading/tooltip_04: Don't forget to build portals in your base to help you travel to distant areas quickly. You never know which part of the base will require your attention.
gui/loading/tooltip_05: Upgrading resource production buildings, like Carbonium and Ironium Factories, increases the extraction rate but not the depletion speed. Each upgrade makes your extractors much more efficient which is crucial, especially in the later stages of the game.
gui/loading/tooltip_06: Each enemy has a different set of strengths and weaknesses. Once you have gathered enough samples of the species, you can review their resistances in your database. One must understand one's enemy to kill it.
gui/loading/tooltip_07: Use the Geoscanner to look for hidden resource caches. They are spread out all over each map and contain large amounts of resource shards or even entirely new deposits. The Geoscanner's signal increases in frequency the closer you are to a hidden cache.
gui/loading/tooltip_08: You can always repair your Mecha-Suit by returning to your Headquarters or Outpost. It's quick and free.
gui/loading/tooltip_09: You can disassemble your old weapons and equipment in order to retrieve some resources from them.
gui/loading/tooltip_10: A key to victory is using multiple types of weapons. Using weapons that consume only one type of ammunition is a fast way to get yourself killed when you run out of it.
gui/loading/tooltip_11: Resource deposits located far from your main base are best exploited by building small, autonomous mining outposts. All solid resources extracted there will be added to your resource pool, even if there is no physical connection between the mining outpost and your main base.
gui/loading/tooltip_12: Hold <img="${build}"> while building energy connectors to automatically build them at the maximum range. You can also build walls this way.
gui/loading/tooltip_13: You can turn off your buildings when they are not needed, this will stop them from using up your energy reserves.
gui/loading/tooltip_14: You can assign and use Hotkeys to place specific buildings faster. Hotkeys can be customized in the 'Controls' menu.
gui/loading/tooltip_15: You can easily replace a tower with a different type of tower by building the new one directly on top of it. The existing tower will automatically be sold to make way for its replacement.
gui/loading/tooltip_16: In multiplayer mode you can quickly teleport to other players by clicking on their icon besides the minimap or by clicking on their arrow when the minimap is maximized.
gui/loading/tooltip_17: Don't rely on one source of energy, some events might cripple you in critical situations. Always have a variety of power plants at your disposal.
gui/loading/tooltip_18: Consider upgrading buildings instead of building new ones. Space management inside your base is critical and usually your limiting factor in layout design.
gui/loading/tooltip_19: You can place buildings on power lines and power hubs. Be careful however, when replacing a hub as this can cut the surrounding buildings off power if they are out of range.
gui/loading/tooltip_20: Diversify your defenses to stand a chance against different kinds of enemies. You don't want to be caught using regular bullets against enemies with physical damage resistance.
gui/loading/tooltip_21: Most alien fauna species have specific damage resistances and weaknesses. Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons that deal different types of damage to increase your chances of survival.
gui/loading/tooltip_22: You can repair the ruins of destroyed buildings to quickly rebuild large portions of your base.
gui/loading/tooltip_23: Repairing buildings before they are completely destroyed costs only a fraction of the resources that are needed to construct a building from scratch or to rebuild it from ruins.
gui/loading/tooltip_24: Activate the picker tool from the build menu or by pressing <img="${picker}">. When active, you can select an existing building from your base to quickly construct the next one of the same type. This removes the need to search for this building in the build menu and is useful for quick base expansion.
gui/loading/tooltip_25: The tools like repair, sell, upgrade, switch, and floor building can be scaled up or down to make those operations faster or more precise.
gui/loading/tooltip_26: The bio-anomalies scattered around Galatea are a great source of new mods, weapons, and building blueprints but activating them can be dangerous. They vary in contents and amount of danger. The white ones are the least dangerous, with blue, violet, and red each containing more treasure and being more protected.
gui/loading/tooltip_27: You can quickly flip pages of the building menu by pressing <img="${page_left}"> and <img="${page_right}">.
gui/loading/tooltip_28: All weapons of higher levels can be equipped with mods to add new abilities or increase their power. Blue weapons have one mod slot, while violet ones have two and red weapons have three mod slots.
gui/loading/tooltip_30: You can disassemble unneeded weapons, upgrades, and mods through the disassembly screen. You can access it through your inventory. Click "Disassembly", select the items you want to get rid of, and enjoy the extra resources.
gui/loading/tooltip_32: Weapons and items you loot from enemies can receive additional bonus characteristics, making them more powerful than the ones you can craft yourself. Bonus stats are marked with a star icon.
gui/loading/tooltip_36: You can quickly find technologies in the research screen by using the search feature. Click the magnifying glass icon in the bottom right corner of the research tree and type in what you want to find.
gui/loading/tooltip_37: After completing all story missions in a biome, you will get the ability to look for new areas of interest in that biome through the Planet Scanner screen.
gui/loading/tooltip_42: The map can be used to teleport to rift gates from anywhere, you don't need to be in range of a portal to teleport.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_29: Press <img="${ping_menu}"> to open the Ping Wheel. It allows you to quickly communicate with your teammates. It also gives you access to emotes.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_31: If your teammate falls in battle, you can reactivate their mech. Walk up to the wreckage and press <img="${interact}">. After that, both you and your teammate will receive a short power boost, increasing damage and durability. Use it to fight back or run away to safety.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_33: The difficulty level of the game adapts dynamically to the number of players. The more players join your session, the more difficult it's going to be to survive.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_34: Your individual progress is saved by the server. You can leave a co-op session and re-join it at any point later. Your weapons, upgrades, and mods will be there , waiting for you.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_35: The player hosting the Co-Op session can pause the server at any time. Have a break every now and again!
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_38: Found an item that you don't want, but could be useful to a teammate? Enter the inventory screen, select that item and press "Share" to let others see it in their inventories as well.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_39: Press <img="${open_chat}"> to use the in-game chat. This is a co-op game, information is critical!
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_40: Reactivating a downed teammate is a priority 1 task. Remember, an alive teammate is the strongest tool in the field.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_41: Staying close to other teammates will grant you a temporary Team Boost. It greatly increases the durability of your Energy Shields.
gui/loading/tooltip_multiplayer_43: Resources are shared across the entire team. Make sure to coordinate your expenses with other players. On the other hand, ammo is not shared. Go wild!
gui/loading_demo_tooltip_01: You're playing a Beta build of the Riftbreaker.\n Please note that you may experience various problems and unfinished/unbalanced game aspects.\n Work in progress :)
gui/menu/crafting/building_requirement: Build an Armory to enable crafting!

gui/menu/difficulty/description_brutal: The Brutal difficulty level is suitable only for the elite few that have mastered strategic base defenses, economy management, and excel at direct combat with enormous swarms of enemies. You will be constantly under attack by alien hordes of epic proportions. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!
gui/menu/difficulty/description_easy: The Easy difficulty level is intended for players that are new to The Riftbreaker and would like to explore the game's features without too much trouble. Alien swarms will attack you from time to time, leaving a lot of time to rebuild and expand your base in between attacks.
gui/menu/difficulty/description_hard: The Hard difficulty level is intended for players that have already finished the game on the Normal difficulty level and are looking for a bigger challenge. Alien swarms will attack you frequently leaving little time to rebuild your base. You should know what you are doing.
gui/menu/difficulty/description_hardcore: Hardcore mode removes the ability to respawn. When Mr. Riggs is destroyed it is game over. Recommended only for super experienced players!
gui/menu/difficulty/description_normal: The Normal difficulty level provides a fair challenge to players that are new to The Riftbreaker but have some experience playing action and strategy games. The alien swarms will attack you at regular intervals, leaving some time to rebuild after each attack wave.
gui/menu/difficulty/description_sandbox: In Sandbox mode you will be free to explore the world and build anything you'd like. The alien horde will not attack you if not provoked.
gui/menu/difficulty/prepare_attack_time_: Time to prepare for an attack

A more deadly mix of corrosive substances allowed to create this version of the cluster grenade with significantly more firepower.
Automated defensive turret with a medium range of operation. Deals Cryo damage and doesn't require external ammunition or energy to shoot. Works for a limited amount of time.
A more powerful version of the Cryo Sentry. Deals more damage, has a wider splash damage radius and remains operational for longer.
Allows you to call in an assortment of various types of drones. They will follow and assist the mech for a limited amount of time. Summoned drones do not count towards the drone limit.
Improved energy cells installed in the drones from this pack allow them to operate longer, and for their CPUs to be massively overclocked, greatly increasing their efficiency.
A part of the basic Mecha-Suit equipment. Provides light in dark areas for a limited amount of time.
The grenade releases a cloud of acidic gas in a relatively large area, dealing damage to all creatures in its vicinity.
The gas in this version of the grenade is kept at a much higher pressure than the original. It disperses at a much higher rate and increased concentration, making it even more effective.
Enhanced version of the standard Grenade, with improved damage and increased blast radius.
Enhanced version of the standard Grenade, with improved damage and increased blast radius.
More powerful explosive withing this grenade results in a much bigger explosion, while maintaining the gravity-bending effect of the original.
More powerful explosive withing this grenade results in a much bigger explosion, while maintaining the gravity-bending effect of the original.

More powerful explosive withing this grenade results in a much bigger explosion, while maintaining the gravity-bending effect of the original.
This type of grenade causes a small explosion accompanied by a sonic blast. It has a large area of effectiveness.
Redesigned housing of this version of the Sonic Grenade greatly enhances the effectiveness of the device.
The most basic, explosive weapon. It’s single use and deals explosive damage in its blast radius. Explodes on hitting the target or after the fuse runs out.
Enhanced version of the standard Grenade, with improved damage and increased blast radius.
Instantly recovers a portion of Mech's hitpoints.
This is a portable holographic projector that can display a replica of the Mecha-Suit once it is set on the ground.
Reduced energy consumption of this version of the projector allows it to stay online for longer periods.
